strings.(깊은 잠의 늪에 빠진 것 같았던 %s의 귓가에 멈춰있던 세계의 소리가: (As though rising from the depths of sleep, %s gradually begins to hear the sounds of the world that had fallen still.)
strings.(조용히 눈을 뜨고 바라본 %s의 시야에 당황한 듯 주위를 살펴보고 있는: (As %s opens their eyes, Jiendia comes into view, looking around in confusion.)
%s, you weren't here a moment ago.
Thank goodness? A moment ago, I was meeting Lord Aaron to ask about my retainer's whereabouts...
Where has Lord Aaron gone? No, this is... Ah...
strings.(지엔이 뭔가 떠올랐는지 힘없이 그대로 주저앉는다.): (As something returns to her, Jien sinks helplessly to the ground.)
%s... I never wanted to remember that time again, but now...
I'm sorry. It feels so much like that time...
strings.(지엔이 자리에서 일어나 멍하니 하늘을 바라본다.): (Jien rises and gazes blankly at the sky.)
strings.오늘은 마치 제가 저주의 주술로 제단에 묶여있던 그날과 비슷한 분위기군요: Today feels much like the day I was bound to the altar by that curse.
strings.마계 군주 럭스의 힘이 묻어있던 단검이 제 피를 원했고, 제게 상처를 만: A dagger bearing the power of Lux, a lord of the Demon Realm, thirsted for my blood and wounded me.
strings.그리고 그 검을 조금 전까지 아론이 들고 있었죠. %s도 그걸 봤겠죠?: And Aaron was holding that very blade until a moment ago. You saw it too, didn't you, %s?
strings.조금 전까지 흔적도 없었던 당신이 여기 지금 내 눈앞에 나타난 데엔 이유: There must be a reason you appeared before me now, when there was no trace of you moments ago.
strings.보통 일이 아닐 거로 생각하지만, 절 믿고 이야기해 주세요. 부탁드립니다: I imagine it is no ordinary matter, but please trust me and tell me.
I don't know where to begin... It will be a long story.
strings.(지엔에게 아틀라스 정원에서 있었던 일과 실바리아 황제인 카이나의 예지,: (You tell Jien about Atlas Garden, the visions of Kaina, Empress of Silvaria, and your visit to Vigrid on the Reverse Side.)
strings.이해되지 않는 일들 투성이지만, 믿도록 하겠습니다. %s의 말이기도 하고: There is much I do not understand, but I will believe you. You are the one telling me, %s, and I myself was once among the world's impossible things.
If I'd been stronger, I could have saved him...
strings.아니에요. 그건 마녀가 작정하고 벌인 일. 레비…. 아, 제 신하인 그가: No. The witch planned this deliberately. Levi... My retainer would not have escaped easily, even if he had been as strong as you, %s.
I should have warned him about the witch beforehand, but I failed to. I bear some responsibility.
...In any case, we must keep searching for him. But %s...
strings.실바리아 제국의 황제께선 한 번도 예지가 틀린 적이 없다고 하셨죠?: You said the Empress of Silvaria's visions have never been wrong?
strings.그냥 지켜보기만 하면 제가 죽거나 다쳤을 테고, 그걸 지켜볼 수 없어서: If you had merely watched, I would have been killed or wounded. You couldn't bear that, so you intervened, and things went awry.
Yes... So we need to find a way to resolve the situation.
strings.한 사람을 중심으로 나누어진 정면과 이면. 이면에서 일을 해결해서 다시: The Front Side and Reverse Side, divided around one person. Just as resolving matters on the Reverse Side brought you back, there must be something to do on the Front Side...
%s, we should go to Atlas Garden.
strings.아틀라스 정원의 문지기에게 묻고 싶은 게 있군요. 어쩌면 답을 얻을 수: There is something I wish to ask the garden's gatekeeper. Perhaps we can find an answer.
strings.위험할 텐데, 괜찮으시겠어요?: It could be dangerous. Are you sure?
I am. Don't worry too much. I won't be a burden.
All right, Lady Jiendia. Follow me.
A large bubble rose before us. We merely touched it, and it brought us here. We were down there only a moment ago...
strings.(지엔이 정원 아래로 보이는 라란 가도를 바라본다.): (Jien looks at Laran Road below the garden.)
%s, there's someone on top of that building.
strings.(지엔 말대로 수조 위에 세워진 하얀 건물 위에서 누군가 이곳을 바라보고: (Just as Jien said, someone watches from a white building standing above a pool.)
strings.(메테우스가 천천히 걸을 때마다 기계 장치 특유의 쇳소리 같은 것이 들려: (Each slow step Metheus takes is accompanied by the metallic sound of machinery.)
strings.(아름다운 은회색 빛을 머금은 신의 피조물이 힘찬 날갯짓을 하며 두 사람: (The divine creation, gleaming a beautiful silver-gray, beats its wings powerfully and approaches the two.)
A being made by a god to guard the garden...
strings.「신을 따르는 자여. 다시 만날 때는 각오가 필요……….」: 「Follower of the gods. You must be prepared when next we meet...」
strings.(경고하듯 말을 꺼낸 메테우스의 움직임이 잠시 멈춘다. 다시 움직이려고: (Speaking as though in warning, Metheus suddenly stops. It seems about to move again, only to freeze once more.)
strings.(멈춰있던 메테우스의 형태가 뒤틀린 것처럼 알 수 없는 형태로 변하기를: (Metheus' motionless body repeatedly twists into unrecognizable shapes. When it finally settles, a bladed fan forms in its hand and unleashes a vast wind.)
strings.(모험가는 지엔디아가 정원의 구조물 뒤로 숨는걸 확인하고, 메테우스가 일: (After making sure Jiendia has taken cover behind a garden structure, the adventurer charges into Metheus' blade-like winds.)
strings.(그리고 다시 또 뒤틀린 형태로 변하려는 메테우스를 향해 공격을 시도한다: (You strike at Metheus as its body begins to twist once again.)
strings.(%s의 공격이 메테우스의 날개에 닿는 순간, 거대한 소용돌이가 일어나: (The instant %s's attack touches Metheus' wing, a tremendous vortex erupts, blowing away everything nearby.)
Stay back, Lady Jiendia. Metheus will attack again...
strings.(지엔이 가리키는 곳을 따라 %s의 시선이 옮겨간다. 언제 하늘로 올라갔: (%s follows Jien's pointing hand. Somehow already airborne, Metheus hangs in the sky, staring into the distance.)
strings.라란 가도가 이어진 마을이 있어요. 루리아 마을…. 설마, 마을을…?: A village along Laran Road. Luria Village... Don't tell me it's going after the village...?
strings.(그 순간, 메테우스가 위로 날아올라 모습을 감춘다.): (At that moment, Metheus rises and disappears from view.)
strings.%s, 침착해요…. 메테우스는 이곳을 떠나지 않을 거예요. 정확하게 말하: Calm down, %s... Metheus will not leave this place. More precisely, it cannot.
I'll explain when we speak with Metheus.
strings.네…. 메테우스를 만나 대화하는 일이 쉽진 않을 거라 생각했는데, 역시나: All right... I thought getting a conversation would be difficult. I was right...
strings.지엔디아 님, 지금 메테우스의 상태가 이상해서 전투를 피할 수는 없을 것: Lady Jiendia, something is wrong with Metheus. I don't think we can avoid a fight.
So as soon as we see it, get as far away as you can. Understood?
I don't think I can remain here much longer...
strings.(%s의 예상대로 전과는 다른 느낌의 메테우스를 만나자마자 전투가 벌어진: (As %s expected, a battle begins the moment you encounter Metheus, whose presence feels different from before.)
strings.(여러 번의 공격이 부딪치던 중, 메테우스가 움직임을 멈추고 멀리서 숨어: (After several exchanges of blows, Metheus stops moving and turns toward Jien, who is hiding in the distance.)
strings.(메테우스가 기괴한 소리와 함께 빠른 속도로 뒤로 물러난다.): (With an eerie sound, Metheus retreats rapidly.)
strings.메테우스가 움직임을 멈추다니…. 메테우스, 내 말 듣고 있어?: Metheus has stopped moving... Metheus, can you hear me?
strings.신을 따르는 자여, 그렇게 부르지 말고 이름을 불러. 길지 않아?: Stop calling me 'follower of the gods.' Use my name. Isn't that a bit long?
You may call me Jien, from the continent of Jiendia.
strings.「지엔…. 그대는 이곳에 오래 있으면 안 된다.」: 「Jien... You must not remain here long.」
I know. I only came to hear what you have to say, then leave.
strings.「나도 모르게 그대를 신이라 생각했다. 지엔, 그대의 시간…, 저기 %s: 「Without realizing it, I mistook you for a god. Jien, your time... and %s's time... are both slightly out of alignment...」
strings.「그대들에게서 황혼 속에 멈췄었던 세계의 공기가 느껴진다….」: 「You carry the air of a world that stopped in twilight...」
strings.「그래서 그대들이 다가왔을 때, 내 시간이 뒤틀렸다. 그리고 정원의 시간: 「When you approached, my time twisted. And all the garden's time was shaken...」
strings.「별의 신조차 손댈 수 없는 이 순간, 그대가 성계신을 만나려 한다면,: 「At this moment, beyond even the star's god to alter, if you attempt to meet the God of the Astral Realm, everything in this moment will stop.」
strings.「돌아가야 한다. 돌려야 한다.」: 「You must return. You must turn it back.」
strings.돌릴 수 있는 방법이 있다는 건가?: There's a way to turn it back?
strings.「이곳엔 진리가 없다. 시간의 진리는 다른 곳에 묻혀 있다.」: 「Truth does not lie here. The truth of time is buried elsewhere.」
strings.「…나는 정원사. 시간의 눈물이 어디론가 사라졌다.」: 「...I am a gardener. The Tear of Time has vanished somewhere.」
strings.(메테우스가 접혀 있던 날개를 펼치고 허공으로 올라간다.): (Metheus unfurls its folded wings and rises into the air.)
strings.「…지엔, 그대는 알 것이다. 그대가 가진 시간이 시작되는 곳을.」: 「...Jien, you will know. The place where the time you carry begins.」
...That answers my question, Metheus. Thank you.
strings.(지엔이 감사의 인사를 전하자 메테우스가 등을 돌린 채로 어디론가 날아간: (As Jien gives her thanks, Metheus turns away and flies off.)
Metheus told me everything it knows, %s...
What? It never said where to go.
The place where my time began to fall out of alignment. Dragon Emperor's Palace.
I never thought I would stand here and look upon Dragon Emperor's Palace again...
strings.(지엔이 감회에 빠졌는지 용제성을 바라보며 말을 잇지 못한다.): (Overcome by memories, Jien gazes at Dragon Emperor's Palace, unable to continue.)
It's been so long since I came here, too.
So much has happened to both of us, %s.
strings.용제성에 가득했던 시간의 망령들도 다 정리됐고…. 계속 정비를 해서 언젠: The phantoms of time that filled Dragon Emperor's Palace have all been dealt with... I want to keep restoring it, until one day people can come and go freely.
I'm going to see Lord Guiyi. If you have a message for him, tell me.
strings.아니에요. 지엔디아 님 덕분에 제가 뭘 어떻게 해야 할지 보이는 것 같아: Please don't be. Thanks to you, Lady Jiendia, I can see what I need to do.
strings.기이 님께서 메테우스가 말했던 시간의 눈물이란 걸 알고 계실지도 모르고요: Lord Guiyi may know about the Tear of Time Metheus mentioned.
I have so much to tell Lord Guiyi, but I'll hold back for now. I feel too sorry...
strings.많이 노력했지만, 저는 제 시간조차도 힘겨워서 기이 님을 밖으로 나오게: I've tried so hard, but I struggle even with my own time. I still haven't found a way to let him leave...
It's all right. Please don't blame yourself.
Then just tell him I miss him dearly...
I will... I'll be right back.
strings.(확실히 돌아오긴 했지만, 모든 게 느리게 느껴지는 건 역시 이 상황이: (I'm definitely back, but everything feels slow. This situation clearly isn't normal...)
strings.(한때는 과거의 영광을 좇던 황제의 자리엔 어리석은 용이 승천하지 못한: (Where an emperor once pursued the glory of the past, only faint traces remain of a foolish dragon's struggle after failing to ascend.)
Nothing has changed here. No one can enter, after all.
strings.(그런 그때, 건물의 부서진 틈으로 들어오는 빛을 맞으며 한 사내가 천천: (Then a man slowly approaches, lit by the sunlight falling through gaps in the ruined building.)
strings.그동안 잘 지내셨나요? 죄송해요. 방법을 찾아서 다시 오겠다는 약속을 지: Have you been well? I'm sorry. I failed to keep my promise to return with a way to help you.
strings.얼마 만에 날 찾아온 거지?: How long has it been since your last visit?
strings.그렇군. 시간이 그렇게나 흘러가는데, 내가 느끼는 시간은 참으로 더디구나: I see. So much time passes, yet what I feel moves so slowly.
strings.어쩔 수 없지. 이조차도 언젠가는 익숙해질 것이다. 적어도 시간에 갇혀: It cannot be helped. Someday even this will become familiar. At least it is better than sleeping, trapped in time.
strings.(기이가 %s에게서 뭔가 느꼈는지 조금 놀란 표정을 짓는다.): (Guiyi looks a little surprised, as though sensing something from %s.)
Your presence feels different. More than simply having grown stronger.
Almost like me, moving while enclosed in a barrier of time...
%s, I will help you. Tell me what happened.
All right, Lord Guiyi... This is how it began...
strings.(용제성의 일이 끝나고 다른 대륙으로 넘어가 이리스를 만나게 됐던 것부터: (You briefly recount what happened after Dragon Emperor's Palace: traveling to another continent, meeting Iris, and the events leading to your current situation.)
strings.(기이가 그동안 %s에게 있었던 일을 듣더니 몹시 놀라워 한다.): (Guiyi listens to all that has happened to %s with astonishment.)
After going through all that... Are you truly all right?
strings.괜찮다고 말해도 속은 말이 아닐 것이다. 미안하다. 그건 그렇고, 지금: You say so, but you must be suffering inside. I'm sorry. Now, to resolve what has happened to you...
strings.잠깐, 내게 생각할 시간을 다오. 오래 걸리지 않을 것이다. 아주 잠깐이: Wait. Give me a moment to think. It won't take long. Just a moment.
The time of the Front Side...
strings.(기이가 생각하는 동안 감았던 눈을 뜨고 %s의 얼굴을 바라본다.): (Guiyi opens the eyes he had closed in thought and looks at %s.)
I don't know whether this will offer a clue...
strings.괜찮아요. 말씀해주시겠어요?: That's all right. Please tell me.
I cast a barrier of time over Dragon Emperor's Palace, stopping the flow of time.
strings.금기였던 이 방법을 사용할 수 있었던 건 선조들로부터 이어진 용의 피 때: I could use that forbidden method because of the dragon blood passed down from my ancestors.
strings.용이 위대하고 신비한 동물이라고 해도 생명에게 주어진 시간을 흔드는 것은: Even for a mighty, mysterious creature like a dragon, disturbing the time granted to living beings is difficult...
strings.하지만, 시간의 결계를 다루는 방법이 기록된 금서엔 이런 내용이 남겨져: But the forbidden book describing how to wield a barrier of time contained these words.
strings.「신의 영역을 들여다본 용이 시간을 흔들었고, 그 공간을 얻기 위해 누군: 「A dragon peered into the realm of the gods and shook time. Someone whispered, seeking to claim that space. In their hands, time became twisted...」
At the time, I did not understand exactly what it meant, so I passed over it. Sigh...
strings.아마도 내 아비가 럭스의 꼬임에 넘어간 건 결국 신이 되고 싶어서였는지도: Perhaps my father fell for Lux's temptations because, in the end, he wanted to become a god...
strings.미안하다. 내가 말해줄 수 있는 건 여기까지인듯 싶군. 네가 고대 시절의: I'm sorry. That seems to be all I can tell you. If you knew a dragon from ancient times, you might learn more...
Oh, an ancient dragon? I do know one.
Remarkable. A dragon from ancient times...
strings.다른 대륙에서 절 도와주신 분이 계세요. 그분께선 오랫동안 세레스 여신과: He helped me on another continent. He has long served Goddess Seres and Goddess Gaia.
Then he should be trustworthy. Perhaps he can give you the answer.
strings.고맙습니다, 기이 님. 시간의 결계와 관련된 걸 물어봐야겠어요. 그리고: Thank you, Lord Guiyi. I'll ask about the barrier of time. And a way for you to leave...
No, %s. Resolve the task before you first.
Then I'll see you later. I'll try to visit sooner next time.
It's all right. The passage of time means little to me now anyway.
strings.맞다. 지엔디아 님께서 전해달란 말이 있었어요. 많이 그리워하고 있다고…: Oh, Lady Jiendia asked me to tell you something. She misses you dearly...
strings.알았다. 그리고 지엔디아에게는…. 아니다, 언제가 될지 모르지만, 내가: I see. And tell Jiendia... No. I don't know when, but I'll tell her myself.
%s. If you need my help, return here. Good luck.
strings.(기이가 %s의 인사와 함께 천천히 방 밖으로 발걸음을 옮긴다.): (As %s bids him farewell, Guiyi slowly walks out of the room.)
strings.이제 뭔가 조금씩 맞춰지는 기분이 드네…. 바로 지엔디아 님께 인사하고: It feels as though the pieces are beginning to fit... I'll say goodbye to Lady Jiendia and go straight to Lord Atkina.
I'm glad you found a clue. And Lord Guiyi seems to be well...
strings.(이야기를 듣던 지엔의 표정이 한결 가벼워진다.): (As she listens, Jien's expression grows lighter.)
Now that I know where to go, I'll head there right away, Lady Jiendia.
strings.저는 저대로 제 신하의 행방을 찾을 방법을 강구하겠습니다. 그리고 아론: I will look for a way to find my retainer. And attend to the matter of Chairman Aaron...
strings.지금 실바리아 제국의 폐하께서 어떤 상탠지 모르니 쉽게 움직일 수는 없겠: Though it will be difficult to act until I know Her Majesty of Silvaria's current condition...
...I hope your time returns to normal as well, %s.
Thank you. I'll see you later.
strings.(불타는 수레바퀴에 아드키나 님이 계시겠지? 일단 가서 말씀드려야겠다.): (Lord Atkina should be in the Burning Wheel. I'd better go tell him.)
strings.(여러 세계의 경계이자 결전을 위해 머물렀던 장소 한쪽, 거대한 존재 하: (At the boundary of several worlds, where the group once gathered for their decisive battle, a single vast being remains on watch.)
strings.(잠깐 쉬고 있던 존재가 인기척을 느꼈는지 조용히 고개를 든다. 그리고: (Sensing an approaching presence during a brief rest, the being quietly raises its head. Eyes gleaming like yellow gems meet the visitor's.)
Have you been well, Lord Atkina?
strings.나는 언제나 잘 지내고 있네. 최근엔 가이아 님의 축복으로 제나디아에도: As always. With Lady Gaia's blessing, I even visited Xenadia briefly recently.
strings.그곳의 공기를 마시는 것만으로도 무척 행복했네. 제나디아를 지키는 시스터: Simply breathing its air made me happy. I spoke at length with the Sisters and priests who guard Xenadia.
They called me their senior. A slightly unfamiliar way to be addressed. Haha.
strings.이스트랜드에서 지엔디아 대륙까진 꽤 먼 거리인데, 어떻게 가셨어요?: It's a long way from Eastland to Jiendia. How did you travel?
strings.원래 내 모습으로 돌아가 날아서 제나디아 땅을 밟았지. 너무 걱정하지 말: I returned to my true form and flew to Xenadia. Don't worry. I have my own way of concealing myself.
I wished to stay longer, but could not leave this place unattended for long, so I returned at once. The purification of Avalon and the surrounding area is still unfinished...
strings.활발하게 움직이던 정령이 느려진 걸 봤네. 서둘러 돌아오니 이 안에서 느: I saw spirits that had been moving briskly begin to slow. When I hurried back, even the air inside here felt different.
I asked Shynic, who discovered this place. She said time had been disturbed... Hmm...
strings.자네의 표정을 보니 뭔가 알고 있는 것 같군. 내게도 할 말이 있는 것: From your expression, you seem to know something. And you have something to tell me. Go ahead.
Yes, Lord Atkina. The reason I came is...
strings.(아드키나에게 그동안 있었던 일을 간단하게 이야기한다.): (You briefly recount recent events to Atkina.)
strings.나와 자네를 비롯해 생명이 사는 이 땅엔 정말 설명할 수 없는 일들이 많: In this land where you, I, and so many living beings dwell, truly inexplicable things happen often.
I won't deny that my long life has made me less easily startled.
strings.어쨌든 자네의 상황이 그렇다면 서둘러야겠군. 내가 알고 있는 걸 이야기하: In any case, if that is your situation, we must hurry. I'll tell you what I know.
strings.시간의 결계를 펼쳤던 이의 말대로 신의 영역을 들여다본 용, 내가 그 자: The dragon who peered into the gods' realm, as the maker of that barrier of time described... I knew him.
Sanak. He was a Pluton Dragon, like me.
strings.그도 나처럼 세레스 님의 뜻으로 대지의 생명을 지키기 위해서 깨어난 존재: Like me, he awakened at Lady Seres' will to protect life upon the land.
strings.고대신과 뒤틀린 자가 격한 감정으로 부딪혔던 황혼 시절과 비스트가 나타났: In the twilight age, when the ancient gods and the Twisted One clashed in fierce emotion, and the chaos when the Beast appeared...
strings.하루가 멀다하고 눈에 보이는 것이 사라지던 시간, 모두가 고통을 견디기: When things vanished before our eyes day after day and everyone struggled to endure their suffering, Sanak happened to open the realm of the gods and look inside.
strings.그는 그 영역을 보고 세레스 님을 비롯한 많은 신을 저주했고, 그중 어떤: After seeing it, he cursed Lady Seres and many other gods. He even tried to kill one of them.
strings.조금 강할 뿐인 생명은 신에게 상대가 될 리 없었지. 그 신께선 세레스: A living creature, however strong, could never rival a god. Not wishing to sadden Lady Seres, that god forgave Sanak and banished him far away.
strings.그리고 사나크가 신의 영역에서 가져간 물건을 찾아서 돌아오기로 했지만,: The god intended to retrieve the object Sanak had taken from the divine realm and return. But that god never came back.
strings.비스트가 세계의 신을 소멸로 이끈 그날…. 그 물건은 어디론가 떨어져 사: On the day the Beast brought a god of this world to annihilation... The object fell somewhere and vanished. It never appeared again.
strings.그렇군요. 그 물건이 혹시 시간과 관계가 있는 걸까요?: I see. Could that object have something to do with time?
The Tear of Time... That is the name the god who forgave Sanak told me.
strings.그 물건에 어떤 능력이 있고, 사나크가 그걸 왜 가져갔는지는 모르겠지만…: I don't know what it can do, or why Sanak took it... But it seems to be what you need now.
strings.언젠가 가이아 님께서 시간의 눈물이 필요할 때가 올지 모른다면서 말씀하셨: Lady Gaia once said the Tear of Time might be needed someday. So I searched likely places with the help of a spirit...
strings.그래. 프뉴마에서 온 정령이 도움을 줬었네. 프레이오스 북서부 하이랜드라: Yes. A spirit from Pneuma helped me. That was when I learned of the Highlands, in northwestern Freios.
strings.아마도 그곳에 시간의 눈물이 잠들어 있을 걸세. 정확한 건 아니고, 그: The Tear of Time is probably dormant there. I can't be certain. Its presence was sensed in the area, so you will have to find it yourself.
strings.프뉴마의 관리자인 아르케에게 물어보면 될 것도 같지만, 지금은 프뉴마로도: We might ask Arche, Pneuma's keeper, but you cannot reach Pneuma or Lady Iris now...
I'm sorry. I want to help, but this is all I can do in the current situation.
strings.혹시 용의 후손인 자가 용의 모습일 때는 어떻던가? 지금 내 모습과 비슷: Tell me, what did that descendant of dragons look like in dragon form? Similar to me?
A little different. Oh, I'll sketch it on some paper. He looked like this...
strings.(아드키나가 %s의 용 그림을 보더니 잠시 말을 잇지 못한다.): (Atkina falls silent for a moment as he studies %s's drawing of a dragon.)
Even a Curiring playing in Dragon Valley could draw better than...
Definitely not a Pluton Dragon. Another dragon clan unknown to me...?
strings.어쨌든 그 용의 후손이 시간의 결계를 사용했단 건, 이미 시간과 관련된: In any case, that descendant's use of a barrier of time means dragon power has already influenced time-related magic.
strings.사나크가 손을 대면서 그 힘이 용과 같은 존재들에게 퍼지거나 사용할 수: It seems certain that, after Sanak touched it, that power spread to beings like dragons, or became accessible to them.
strings.혹시 사나크의 행방을 아시나요?: Do you know where Sanak is?
strings.정령들이 하이랜드 어딘가에서 잠깐 봤었다는데, 금방 자취를 감췄다고 했었: The spirits briefly saw him somewhere in the Highlands, but said he soon disappeared.
I see. Lord Atkina, I'd better be going.
strings.그런데 혼자 괜찮겠나? 아마도 지금 상황을 느껴 움직이는 자들도 있을 텐: Will you be all right alone? Others may already have sensed the situation and begun to act...
strings.다른 사람과 함께 가보는 건 어떤가? 일반 사람들은 몰라도 아발론의 일을: Why not take someone with you? An ordinary person might not help, but one of the Champions who faced Avalon with us...
They probably are, but Valdrick should be available.
I'm sure Valdrick is busy too.
strings.아드키나 님, 하이랜드에 가서 말씀해 주신 물건을 찾아볼게요. 아마도 그: Lord Atkina, I'll go to the Highlands and search for the object you described. If it's there...
strings.제 시간, 아니 이 상황도 제대로 돌아오겠죠. 다시 이리스에게 갈 수도: My time—this whole situation—should return to normal. And I should be able to reach Iris again...
Thank you. I'll see you later.
strings.(시간의 눈물이 있는 하이랜드…. 분명 프레이오스의 북서부라고 하셨지?): (The Highlands, where the Tear of Time lies... He said northwestern Freios, didn't he?)
strings.(그러면 루리아 마을 마티아스 씨에게 하이랜드가 어디인지 물어보자. 거기: (I'll ask Matthias in Luria Village where the Highlands are. That's in western Freios, after all...)
strings.(다시 찾은 루리아 마을, 여전히 아름답고 평화로운 느낌이지만, 멀리 보: (Back in Luria Village, everything still seems beautiful and peaceful. Yet Atlas Garden in the distance feels out of place.)
It may look strange, but nothing serious has happened. It should be all right...
strings.젊은 사람이 무슨 한숨을 그렇게 쉬시나. 그 정도로는 프레이오스를 땅으로: Why is someone so young sighing so much? That won't bring Freios crashing to the ground.
Of course it mustn't, and it won't. A joke. Just a joke.
strings.표정이 너무 안 좋아 보여서 무슨 고민이라도 있는 줄 알았는데, 괜찮으신: You looked so troubled, I wondered if something was wrong. Are you all right?
I'm feeling better now, thanks to you.
strings.내가 뭘 했다고. 어쨌거나 다행이군. 언제나 도움이 필요하면 이야기하시게: I hardly did anything. Glad to hear it, anyway. Tell me whenever you need help. I'm the village chief—no, representative, after all.
Besides, you've helped me so much, %s. I want to help in return.
What? I haven't done anything for you...
strings.쥰 말이야, 쥰. 헤프링하고 노느라 정신없던 쥰이 %s 만난 후로는 말을: Jun, I mean. Jun. Used to be so busy playing with Hefring, but after meeting you, %s, the child actually listens. How did you do it?
Oh, well... I promised Juen I'd tell some interesting stories.
strings.하하, 그랬군. 어쩐지 언제 오나 유적지도 덜 가고 기다리고 있어서 말이: Haha, that explains it. There have been fewer trips to the ruins and more waiting for your return. Every day, asking Helena and everyone else whether they've seen %s.
strings.갑자기 일이 생겨서 쥰을 못 만났어요. 지금은 안 될 것 같고, 조금만: Something came up suddenly, so I haven't seen Jun. I can't just now. Could you ask for a little more patience?
Of course. But make sure the stories are good.
I will. Oh, right. Matthias, do you happen to...
strings.하이랜드로 가려면 어떻게 가는지 아시나요?: Know how to reach the Highlands?
The Highlands? You mean Invernel? Of course.
strings.하이랜드는 대륙에서 제일 높은 북서쪽 지역의 이름, 인버넬은 하이랜드의: The Highlands are the continent's highest region, in the northwest. Invernel is the only village there.
strings.옛날부터 전설 같은 게 많아서 성스러운 힘이 있는 곳이라는 소문이 돌았지: There have always been many legends, and rumors of sacred power. Religious orders even built facilities there.
strings.참 특이한 곳이지. 지금은 보기 드문 그리폰도 있고, 한때는 그곳을 차지: A very unusual place. There are griffins, rare nowadays. Several powers once fought to claim it.
(It really doesn't sound like an ordinary place.)
strings.헬레나 님 집 뒤쪽에 있는 큰 길로 쭉 나가면 북쪽으로 가는 가도가 보일: Follow the main road behind Helena's house until you see the highway heading north. Keep north along it, and you'll reach the Highlands.
As it happens, a woman from Invernel is here looking for someone to travel with.
strings.10년 전부터 마수와 마족들이 몰려와 일부가 폐허가 됐는데, 여전하다고: Magical beasts and demons began pouring in ten years ago, leaving part of it in ruins. I hear it's still much the same. Too dangerous to travel alone...
I'd feel reassured if it were you.
strings.큰길 앞에서 갈 사람이 있나 찾아보고 있어. 같이 갈 사람이 있다면 전해: By the main road, looking for a traveling companion. Shall I tell her someone's willing?
No need. I'll go speak to her. Thank you, Matthias.
strings.이 정도 가지고 뭘. 가는 길 조심하고 여성 분도 잘 데려다 줘. 그리고: It's nothing. Take care on the road and see her home safely. Come visit again afterward.
strings.(마티아스가 %s의 어깨를 살짝 두드려 주고는 집 안으로 들어간다.): (Matthias lightly pats %s on the shoulder, then goes inside his house.)
strings.(마티아스 씨 덕분에 하이랜드 이야기도 많이 들었네.): (Thanks to Matthias, I learned quite a bit about the Highlands.)
strings.어떡하지. 그냥 갈까?: What should I do? Just go?
I only need to make it to the ruins somehow. How did I end up all the way here...?
strings.(마티아스 말대로, 헬레나의 집 뒤 큰 길가 앞으로 한 여성이 보인다.): (Just as Matthias said, a woman stands by the main road behind Helena's house.)
strings.(팔과 이마에 있는 특별한 문양의 헤나와 쉽게 볼 수 없는 복식이 인상적: (The woman, striking in her unusual clothing and distinctive henna patterns on her arms and forehead, steps back in surprise.)
strings.마을 대표님께 인버넬에 같이 가실 분을 구한다고 들었는데, 맞으시죠?: The village representative said you were looking for someone to go to Invernel with you. Is that right?
strings.(조금 전까지 울상이었던 여성이 환한 미소와 함께 %s의 두 손을 붙잡는: (The woman, who had looked close to tears, breaks into a bright smile and takes both of %s's hands.)
strings.그럼, 저와 같이 가시겠어요?: Then would you like to travel with me?
I'd love to. I need to get back, but I couldn't manage alone.
strings.돌아가야 한다고 하셨는데…. 원래 인버넬주민이신가요?: You said you need to get back... Are you from Invernel?
strings.네, 잃어버린 게 있어서 찾다가 루리아까지 오게 됐어요. 그 먼 거리를: Yes. I was looking for something I'd lost and ended up in Luria. I never thought I'd come so far.
strings.잃어버린 건 찾으셨어요?: Did you find what you lost?
strings.찾아서 일단 돌려보내긴 했는데, 과연 잘 돌아갔으려나. 후후. 어쨌든 하: I found it and sent it back ahead, though I wonder whether it made it home. Hehe. Anyway, that's done, so I should return too.
strings.(여성이 살짝 부끄러운 듯 고개를 살짝 흔든다.): (The woman shakes her head slightly, looking a little embarrassed.)
I'm Trisha. Just Trisha, please. No titles needed.
strings.제가 인버넬에서 태어나고 자라 다른 지역 사람을 보는 게 익숙하지 않아서: I was born and raised in Invernel. I'm not used to meeting people from elsewhere, so I'm a little awkward.
strings.괜찮아요. 저도 다른 곳에서 온 사람이니까 크게 신경 쓰지 마세요. 저는: It's all right. I'm from somewhere else myself, so don't worry. I'm %s... Please just use my name too.
strings.네, %s. %s…? 어디선가 들어본 이름인 것 같아요. 아, 사제님이: Of course, %s. %s...? I think I've heard that name somewhere. Oh, the famous adventurer the priest mentioned...
It's a pleasure to meet you.
Likewise. Though I'm not really famous or anything.
strings.(왠지 모르게 보기만 해도 기분이 좋아지는 사람이야.): (Somehow, just looking at her lifts my spirits.)
strings.그런데 %s, 인버넬엔 무슨 일로 가시는지 물어봐도 될까요?: May I ask what brings you to Invernel, %s?
I'm looking for something too. Though I don't know if I'll find it...
I see. I don't know what it is, but I'm sure you'll find it.
strings.트리샤, 고마워요. 그러면 언제 출발하실 거죠? 저는 당장이라도 가고 싶: Thank you, Trisha. When shall we leave? I'd like to go right away.
A griffin never hesitates when it wants to fly. You remind me of one.
strings.후후, 그리폰이라고 한 건 농담이에요. 제가 가는 길을 알고 있으니까 안: Hehe, the griffin was a joke. I know the way, so I'll guide you.
strings.(뭐지? 갑자기 이상한 기분이 드는데….): (What was that? I suddenly felt something strange...)
Ahaha. I think it's just my imagination.
strings.아…. 가끔 그럴 때 있죠. 후후. 이제 갈까요?: Oh... That happens sometimes. Hehe. Shall we go?
strings.(모험가가 라란 가도 방향 하늘을 바라보지만, 하늘엔 한 자리를 지키고: (The adventurer looks toward the sky above Laran Road, but only Atlas Garden floats there, unmoving.)
strings.(모험가가 트리샤와 함께 루리아 마을을 떠나고 얼마 뒤, 아틀라스 정원: (Shortly after the adventurer leaves Luria Village with Trisha, something enormous appears from the direction of Atlas Garden, seemingly carrying a boy.)
strings.저 인간, 뭐야? 날 알아본 건 아니겠지…?: What was with that human? They didn't spot me, did they...?
With my time, hiding a little brat like you is effortless.
strings.누구보고 꼬맹이래? 당장 떨어뜨린다?: Who are you calling a brat? Want me to drop you?
strings.(허공에 떠있는 마도골렘 리카리아를 한팔로 붙잡고 있던 여성이 노네임을: (Hanging from the airborne magic golem Licaria by one arm, a woman gives No Name a mocking smile.)
strings.(일반적인 존재라면 팔을 내리는 순간, 바닥으로 떨어질 테지만, 여성은: (An ordinary being would fall the moment they let go, but the woman rises lightly into the air like a butterfly.)
strings.대공이 도움을 부탁할 정도면 보통 마족이 아니란 건 알았지만…. 뭐, 칭: I knew you couldn't be an ordinary demon if the Grand Duke asked for your help... Well, I'll give you that. Ugh, what are you doing?
strings.(여성이 손을 뻗어 노네임의 얼굴을 붙잡고, 잡아당긴다.): (The woman reaches out, seizes No Name's face, and pulls him toward her.)
strings.내가 얼마나 네 편의란 걸 봐줘야 하지?: How much more am I expected to accommodate you?
strings.(여성의 이마에 있는 길고 뾰족한 뿔이 노네임의 이마에 닿는다. 그러자: (The long, sharp horn on the woman's forehead touches No Name's. A sharp cry escapes his lips.)
strings.나는 이름도 없는 네가 우습게 볼 대상이 아니란다. 머리에 구멍이 나고: I am not someone a nameless child like you may look down on. Show some manners, unless you want a hole in your head.
strings.(노네임의 시야가 고통과 함께 점점 붉은 색으로 채워진다.): (Along with the pain, red gradually floods No Name's vision.)
strings.아니, 척이라도 하는 건 어때?: Or at least pretend to have some.
(Satisfied with No Name's answer, the woman called Queen quietly draws back, then reaches out to stroke his head.)
strings.이제 알겠죠? 그레모리 일족의 퀸에게 무례하게 대하면 안 된다는 걸?: Now you understand? You must not be rude to the queen of the Gremory clan.
strings.그래야 말 잘듣는 아이죠. 후후. 미안해요. 나도 모르게 그만 상처를 줬: There's a good child. Hehe. I'm sorry. I hurt you without meaning to.
My time will erase your wound.
strings.(그레모리 퀸의 말과 함께 손 끝에서 불길한 녹색 빛이 흘러나와 노네임의: (As the Gremory Queen speaks, an ominous green light flows from her fingertips toward No Name's wound.)
strings.(퀸이 만들어낸 빛이 머물다 사라진 자리엔 조금 전까지 있었던 상처의 흔: (Where the queen's light lingers and fades, no trace of the wound remains. Not even the blood that flowed from it.)
So this is the queen's power...
strings.이 정도로 놀라기엔 아직 이르지 않나요?: Isn't it a little early to be amazed?
Now, little brat, follow that human. I'll inform the Grand Duke.
See you shortly. I'll catch up.
(With a brilliant smile, the Gremory Queen vanishes as though evaporating.)
strings.다 왔어요. 이 구조물을 기준으로 북쪽에 보이는 사원 건물까지 인버넬이에: We're here. Invernel stretches from this structure to the temple you can see to the north.
strings.(트리샤가 멀리 바위산 위로 우뚝 세워져 있는 하얀 사원 건물을 가리킨다: (Trisha points to a white temple rising atop the distant rocky mountain.)
The Highlands are enormous. I didn't realize even where we're standing was part of the village.
strings.사원과 거주지, 교단에서 관리하는 땅까지 인버넬인데, 지금 여기는 폐허가: The temple, the homes, and the land managed by the order all belong to Invernel. But this part is in ruins. There's little we can do.
strings.(트리샤의 시선이 머문 곳에 부서진 구조물과 함께 꽃과 나무 잡초들이 마: (Where Trisha looks, flowers, trees, and weeds grow wild and tangled among broken structures.)
strings.안쪽하고 분위기가 많이 다른 것 같죠?: It feels quite different from farther inside, doesn't it?
strings.여기는 폐허지대, 저쪽은 안전지대라고 불러요. 하이랜드 위에 있는 같은: We call this the Ruins, and that area the Safe Zone. Both are part of Invernel in the Highlands, but now they're separate districts.
strings.언제부턴가 마족과 악마, 그들이 부리는 마수가 나타나고 무분별하게 공격받: At some point, demons, devils, and the magical beasts they commanded began appearing. They attacked indiscriminately and destroyed buildings.
strings.최근 10년 동안 심각한 피해가 이어지고, 사원이 있는 북쪽을 제외하면: The damage has been severe over the past ten years. Almost everything except the north, where the temple stands, is in ruins.
In the end, at the order's urging and by imperial command, we had to abandon half of Invernel.
That's how it became divided into the Safe Zone and the Ruins.
strings.그렇게 위험한 장소라면서 트리샤는 왜 폐허지대 안쪽으로 데려다 달라고 한: If it's so dangerous, why did you ask me to bring you into the Ruins, Trisha?
strings.그리폰 일 때문이라도 와야 해서요. 그리고 늘 데려다주시는 분들도 있어서: I have to come here for my work with the griffins. And there are people who escort me regularly, so it's all right.
strings.하이랜더 클레어나 칼루소 전투 사제님. 알바생 로말리우스가 도와주시거든요: Claire the Highlander, Battle Priest Caluso, and Romalius, our part-time worker, help me. You needn't worry too much.
strings.(하이랜더와 전투 사제는 알겠는데, 알바생?): (A Highlander and a battle priest, I understand. But a part-time worker?)
strings.(트리샤와 여러 대화를 하면서 걸어가던 중, %s의 옆으로 누군가가 스윽: (As you walk and talk with Trisha, someone quietly approaches beside %s and begins walking along.)
Don't be startled. I know this one.
strings.(네발짐승의 몸에 새의 얼굴, 날렵한 날개가 달린 동물이 볼을 붉히며 트: (An animal with a quadruped's body, a bird's face, and sleek wings gazes at Trisha, its cheeks flushed.)
Yes, a griffin. The village children have trouble saying it, so they call them 'grippons.' Now the griffins think that's their name too.
strings.(그리폰이 구리퐁이라는 말에 귀를 쫑긋거린다.): (The griffin pricks up its ears at 'grippon.')
strings.맞아요. 일부 사람에게는 마수로도 알려진 동물이죠. 그래도 이 지역에 있: That's right. Some people consider them magical beasts. The griffins here are friendly with humans, though.
strings.이건 어디까지 사람의 손길을 탄 아이들에 한정된 이야기이긴 하지만요. 안: Only the ones raised around people, of course. Hello, Salty.
strings.(옆에 있던 그리폰이 괜찮다는 것처럼 트리샤에게 다가와 몸을 비빈다.): (The griffin approaches and rubs against Trisha as though reassuring her.)
strings.할레인 일족의 일원인 제가 대표로 그리폰을 훈련하고 길들이고 있어요. 벌: As a member of the Hallein clan, I oversee the training and taming of griffins. It's been over ten years now.
The Hallein clan and griffins... Oh... Near the Guild Union...
Ahaha... Some griffins went as far as El Anoir and caused trouble. Catching them and sorting it out was quite an ordeal...
I wish we could clear up the Guild Union's misunderstanding, but it hasn't been easy.
I've done this work for a while, but sometimes I wonder.
strings.야생의 그리폰을 길들이는 게 사람에게는 좋지만, 정작 그리폰이 좋은 건지: Taming wild griffins is good for people. But I don't know whether it's good for the griffins.
strings.일족을 비롯해, 많은 사람들과 함께하기 위한 선택이긴 하지만, 그게 정답: It's a choice we've made so our clan and many others can live together. But that doesn't make it the right answer.
strings.그렇죠? 그래서 가끔은 정답이 있었으면 좋겠어요. 정답이 있었다면 니르바: Isn't it? Sometimes I wish there were a right answer. If there had been, perhaps Nirvana...
I've been talking only about myself.
Not at all. Shall we keep going?
strings.(트리샤가 부서진 구조물 사이로 보이는 길로 들어가자, 움직임이 조금씩: (As Trisha enters a path among the broken structures, her movements gradually slow.)
strings.(트리샤가 뒤를 돌아보는 순간, 느려지던 움직임이 다시 원래대로 돌아온다: (The moment Trisha turns back, her slowed movements return to normal.)
strings.뭔가 밟은 것 같아서요. 나뭇가지네요. 아하하, 역시 처음 오는 장소라: I thought I stepped on something. Just a twig. Ahaha. I suppose I can't help feeling nervous in an unfamiliar place.
Oh, I see. I was nervous when I came all the way to Luria Village, too. Hehe.
strings.(한참을 걸어 두 사람의 발걸음이 멈춘 곳에는 예스러운 느낌이 가득한 구: (After a long walk, the two stop before a half-ruined structure with an old-fashioned air.)
(Trisha's movements keep slowing and returning to normal, as though time itself were flickering.)
strings.(하이랜드에 오고 나서부터 이런 현상이 계속되고 있어….): (This has kept happening since we reached the Highlands...)
strings.%s, 저는 여기서 다른 사람을 기다렸다가 함께 들어갈게요. 그동안 밀린: %s, I'll wait here for someone else, then go farther in with them. I have overdue journal entries to write, too...
Head straight north to reach the Safe Zone.
strings.저 물건들, 전부 트리샤 물건이에요?: Are all those things yours, Trisha?
strings.(한쪽에 트리샤의 것과 비슷한 문양이 그려진 물건들이 정리된 채 놓여있다: (Objects bearing patterns similar to Trisha's are neatly arranged to one side.)
strings.할레인 사람들 물건이에요. 원래 여기가 할레인 사람들이 모여 살던 구역이: They belong to the Hallein people. Our people used to live together in this district.
strings.마족이나 마수, 사나운 동물들이 많이 나타나면서 사람들 대부분이 고향을: As more demons, magical beasts, and vicious animals appeared, most left their homeland. The few who stayed live in the Safe Zone.
strings.제가 폐허지대에서 그리폰을 돌보면서 조금씩 물건을 정리하고 있어요. 예전: I've been sorting these things little by little while tending the griffins in the Ruins. It reminds me of my childhood...
Our house used to stand right here.
strings.그랬군요. 그런데 여기서 그리폰을 돌보고 있었다고요? 위험하지 않아요?: I see. But you tend the griffins here? Isn't it dangerous?
There are reasons for that. Oh...
Can you hear it? Griffins are howling in the distance.
strings.(일행을 따라온 그리폰도 고개를 들고 하울링하려는 순간, 트리샤와 눈이: (The griffin that followed you lifts its head to howl as well, but closes its beak when it meets Trisha's eyes.)
Reading the room, are you, Salty?
strings.(솔티라는 이름의 그리폰이 뭔가 바라는 듯한 표정으로 트리샤에게 다가온다: (The griffin named Salty approaches Trisha with an expectant look.)
strings.(트리샤가 익숙한 솜씨로 그리폰에게 먹이를 주는 동안, 폐허지대 여기저기: (As Trisha feeds it with practiced ease, griffin cries echo throughout the Ruins.)
strings.웬만해선 그리폰들이 저렇게 한꺼번에 우는 적이 없는데…. 도대체 무슨 일: They almost never call all at once like this... What's happening? They used to follow Nirvana's calls, but...
Stay here a moment, Trisha. I'll take a look.
But I should check on the griffins...
strings.안 돼요. 아무리 트리샤가 이곳을 잘 안다고 해도 지금은 위험할 수도 있: No. However well you know this place, it could be dangerous right now.
strings.…네, 그러면 약속해 주세요. 금방 돌아오겠다고요. 나쁜 일에 휘말리지: ...All right. Then promise me you'll come back soon. And won't get caught up in anything bad.
Wait here with this fellow. I'll take a quick look and return.
No, it can't be. Nirvana... Ah!
strings.(트리샤가 울음소리가 들려오는 곳을 바라보다가 뒤를 돌아선 순간, 다가온: (Watching the direction of the cries, Trisha turns and bumps into the returning adventurer.)
strings.(그리폰이 재빠르게 부리로 넘어질 뻔한 트리샤의 옷을 붙잡고 일으켜 세운: (The griffin swiftly catches Trisha's clothing in its beak, steadying her before she falls.)
strings.(트리샤가 그리폰을 쓰다듬으며 간식을 하나 꺼내준다.): (Trisha strokes the griffin and takes out a treat.)
strings.트리샤, 걱정하는 그런 일은 없었어요. 우리가 여기 올 때보다 그리폰이: Nothing like what you feared, Trisha. There were just more griffins gathered than when we arrived.
Looking closely, they seemed to be sharing bread someone had thrown to them.
Griffins shouldn't eat human food... Sigh.
strings.(솔티라 불린 그리폰이 빵이란 말에 눈을 반짝이지만, 트리샤가 인상을 쓰: (Salty's eyes sparkle at the word 'bread,' but the griffin droops when Trisha frowns.)
Who is Nirvana, by the way? I think you mentioned that name before we left.
strings.니르바나는… 어릴 적부터 함께 자란 그리폰이에요. 처음으로 길들인 그리폰: Nirvana is... a griffin I grew up with. The first one I ever tamed.
I see. I'd like to meet Nirvana sometime.
I'm sorry. Across the rainbow bridge...
strings.그게 아니라…. 10년 전, 어느 날 가족과 다른 지역에 갔다가 돌아오는: No, it's not that... One day ten years ago, my family and I encountered demons and magical beasts on our way back from another region.
Nirvana had been waiting for us. After saving my family, Nirvana suddenly disappeared.
strings.전에도 갑자기 사라지긴 했어도, 며칠 후에 다시 돌아오곤 했거든요. 하지: It had happened before, but Nirvana always came home after a few days. This time, there was no return.
strings.그래서 지금까지 찾고 또 찾고 있지만, 프레이오스 대륙 어디서도 니르바나: I've searched and searched ever since, but no one anywhere in Freios has seen Nirvana.
strings.여기 있는 그리폰보다도 몸집이 세 배 정도 더 큰 아이를 본 사람이 없다: A griffin three times the size of the one here, and no one has seen a thing...
strings.그래도 어딘가에 살아있을 거라 생각해요. 니르바나는 영리하고 착한 아이니: Still, I believe Nirvana is alive somewhere. Such a clever, gentle creature.
I'm sure Nirvana is doing well, just as you say.
Oh, Romalius? What brings you out here...?
strings.(트리샤가 %s의 뒤에서 누군가 나타나자 놀란 표정으로 바라본다.): (Trisha looks surprised as someone appears behind %s.)
strings.(은발의 붉은 눈을 한 사내가 모험가와 가볍게 눈을 맞춘다.): (A silver-haired man with red eyes briefly meets the adventurer's gaze.)
strings.(그 순간, 트리샤 뿐만 아니라 앞에 서 있는 사내의 움직임도 느려졌다: (At that moment, not only Trisha but the man before you slows, then speeds up again. Once more, only the adventurer notices.)
strings.트리샤, 손님과 함께 온 건가? 반갑군. 나는 인버넬에서 지내는 로말리우: Trisha, have you brought a guest? A pleasure. I'm Romalius. I live in Invernel...
strings.(모험가가 로말리우스 머리에 달린 검은 뿔을 발견하자마자 놀라 무기를 든: (The adventurer spots the black horns on Romalius' head and raises a weapon in alarm. Trisha catches %s's wrist to stop you.)
Romalius is a demon, but he has changed sides.
strings.전향이요? 그걸 어떻게 믿죠?: Changed sides? How can you trust that?
Lady Lydia, the demigod, broke his horns and made him unable to use magic.
strings.트리샤 말이 맞아. 리디아가 내 뿔을 꺾었지. 그래도 믿지 못하겠다면 이: Trisha is right. Lydia broke my horns. If you still don't believe me, look at this.
strings.(로말리우스가 품에서 뭔가를 꺼내 %s에게 보여준다.): (Romalius takes something from his clothing and shows it to %s.)
A temporary residence permit certified by the palace. I also have the Resedia Order's permission.
strings.나는 너와 싸울 생각이 없어. 그래도 믿지 못하겠다면 당장 날 죽여. 저: I have no intention of fighting you. If you still don't believe me, kill me now. I won't resist.
%s? Is that your name? I've heard it before. It's good to meet you.
strings.군단장들하고 시끄러운 까마귀, 그리고 짜증 나는 인큐버스도 쓰러뜨렸다면서: They say you defeated the legion commanders, that noisy crow, and the irritating incubus.
I keep hearing about it, whether I want to or not.
Trisha probably has no idea just how remarkable you are.
strings.강한 사람이라는 건 알지만요. 그보다. 로말리우스는 여기는 무슨 일로 오: I know you're strong, at least. But Romalius, what brings you here?
strings.교단 식당에서 야채를 다듬는 중이었는데, 칼루소 사제가 시급 두 배로 줄: I was trimming vegetables in the order's kitchen. Priest Caluso offered double the hourly pay if I'd check for demons nearby.
strings.힘은 못 써도 마족들이 나타나면 대충은 느껴지거든. 이자들이 또 어디서: Even without my powers, I can roughly sense when demons appear. Enough to know they've come to cause trouble somewhere. An inconvenient instinct.
strings.오, 좋은 표현이야. 내가 의외로 괜찮은 레이더라서 몇 번 알려주기도 했: Oh, a good description. I'm a surprisingly useful radar. I've warned them a few times.
strings.동족이라…. 마족에게는 동족이 의미 없어. 힘이 없으면 죽이려 들거나 무: My own kind... That means nothing to demons. If you're weak, they'll kill you or force you beneath their feet.
Other races can be similar, but I think they're at least better than demons.
strings.로말리우스, 이러다 해지겠어요. 탐색은 다 끝났어요?: Romalius, the sun will set at this rate. Have you finished searching?
Finished ages ago... Oh! I need to hurry to my next job.
Romalius, I have a favor to ask.
strings.돌아가실 때, 이 분을 모시고 마을에 가주세요. 저는 이따가 칼루소 사제: Please take our guest into the village when you go back. I'll return with Priest Caluso later.
I'll make you something delicious afterward.
Oh, Trisha's cooking is always welcome. Exactly to my taste.
strings.트리샤. 나도 그리폰을 찾아봤는데, 잘 안 보이더라고. 분명 내가 밥을: Trisha, I looked for that griffin too, but couldn't find it. I'm sure it was one I fed...
I see. It can't be helped. I'll look again tomorrow.
strings.괜찮겠어요, 트리샤?: Will you be all right, Trisha?
Priest Caluso is nearby. Don't worry too much.
In that case... See you later, Trisha.
I hope you find what you're looking for.
I'm off, Trisha. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.
And with you, Romalius. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.
Come, %s. Follow me. You'll see what a wonderful place it is.
So that's a card personally authorized by the empress. I'm jealous.
strings.(로말리우스가 눈을 반짝거리며 %s의 카드를 바라본다.): (Romalius gazes at %s's card with sparkling eyes.)
strings.그것만 있으면 무조건 신분이 보증되고 제국의 모든 혜택을 받을 수 있다고: I've heard it guarantees your identity everywhere and grants every benefit the empire offers.
strings.그만큼 네가 대단한 사람이란 거지. 제국에서도 인정받고, 나같은 존재에게: That's how remarkable you are. Acknowledged by the empire, and even by someone like me.
strings.말씀만이라도 고마워요. 그건 그렇고 안전지대가 폐허지대에서 보는 것과는: Thank you for saying so. The Safe Zone certainly looks different up close than it did from the Ruins.
strings.(성처럼 굳게 벽을 세워 단단한 느낌이 가득한 사원 건물과 하이랜드 지역: (A place combining a temple enclosed by sturdy, fortress-like walls with the homes of people who live in the Highlands.)
strings.(발을 내딛은 인버넬의 안전지대는 성스럽고 단아한 느낌이 나면서도 여느: (The Invernel Safe Zone feels sacred and serene, yet bustles with life like any other village.)
Doesn't it? Maybe because a demigod recommended it, but I love this place.
strings.10년 전에는 사람들의 거주지가 저 아래쪽까지여서 거의 수도 정도로 컸다: They say that ten years ago, the homes stretched all the way down there. It was almost the size of a capital.
strings.그러면 판데모니움 정도로 큰 건가?: Would that make it as big as Pandemonium?
strings.고향과 같은 곳이지만 다시 돌아가고 싶지 않은 그런 애증의 장소지. 이런: Something like home. A place I both love and hate, and never want to return to. Enough of that dull subject.
strings.%s, 인버넬에는 뭘 찾으러 왔다고 했지? 너 같은 사람이 인버넬에 온거: %s, you said you came to Invernel to find something. For someone like you to come here...
strings.보통 물건은 아니겠지. 어쩌면 마족들이 찾는 것과 비슷한 건가?: It can't be an ordinary object. Perhaps it's similar to what the demons are after?
No need to look so surprised. Haha.
strings.흠…, 그게 뭔지 모르겠지만, 네가 먼저 찾았으면 좋겠어. 적어도 마족들: Hmm... I don't know what it is, but I hope you find it first. It'll be put to better use in your hands than in theirs.
It's not as though you trust me...
strings.널 믿는 것보다는 마족을 제외한 보통 생명의 가능성을 믿는 것뿐이야. 적: I believe in the potential of ordinary life, apart from demons, more than I trust you personally. Trusting humans is at least a better choice than trusting demons.
strings.어렵게 생각할 필요 없어. 그냥 특이한 동네 주민, 적은 아닌 그런 존재: No need to overthink it. Just consider me an unusual neighbor. Someone who isn't your enemy.
strings.내가 직접 마을을 안내해주고 싶지만, 나는 알바를 하러 가야 해서, 이만: I'd like to show you around myself, but I have a job to get to. We should part here.
strings.마을을 좀 둘러보다가 필요한 게 있으면 알렉시스를 찾으면 돼. 알렉시스가: Have a look around the village. If you need anything, find Alexis. If Alexis looks unwilling to work, show that card.
strings.그거 가지고 뭘. 내가 지금 최선이자 최고의 시간을 잘 보내는 것처럼 %: It's nothing. Just as I'm making the best of my time now, may Nornir bless your time with happiness, %s.
strings.(로말리우스가 가볍게 웃으며 사원 건물이 있는 방향으로 걸어간다.): (Romalius gives a light smile and walks toward the temple.)
strings.…신기한 마족이네. 하긴, 벨레드 같은 경우도 있으니까 저런 마족도 있을: ...An unusual demon. Then again, there's Veled. I suppose someone like him can exist too.
The best use of my time... For me, that means finding the Tear of Time.
strings.그러면 다른 사람들에게 정보를 좀 얻어 보자. 일단 로말리우스에게 특이한: I'll ask the others for information. Romalius didn't seem to have any particular leads...
strings.(지금도 사람들의 움직임이 느려졌다가 다시 돌아오고 있어. 이게 계속 반: (People's movements keep slowing and returning to normal. This can't go on. I need to find a solution quickly...)
strings.(인버넬 안전지대 중심 거리, 일반적인 주민의 모습으로 보이지 않는 존재: (On the main street of Invernel's Safe Zone, someone who looks unlike an ordinary resident surveys the surroundings with sparkling eyes.)
strings.여기는 확실히 특종거리가 많아 보인다무!: This place looks full of scoops! Squawk!
strings.(수인이라고 하기엔 커다란 앵무새처럼 보이는 존재가 특정 직업처럼 보이는: (Rather than a beastperson, the figure resembles a large parrot dressed for some particular profession.)
strings.(기자? 작가? 일반적인 주민은 아닌 것 같은데, 한번 물어봐야겠다.): (A reporter? A writer? Doesn't look like an ordinary resident. I should ask.)
strings.(카메라를 들고 있던 커다란 앵무새가 자신을 부르는 목소리에 놀라 물러난: (The large parrot holding a camera recoils at the voice addressing it.)
strings.혹시 제보하실 내용이라도 있으신가요?: Do you have a tip to share?
strings.(조금 전까지도 말끝마다 '무'를 붙인 커다란 앵무새가 모노클을 고쳐 쓰: (The large parrot, who had been ending every sentence with a squawk, adjusts its monocle and pretends not to be startled.)
A tip? No. I have a question.
Oh-ho, you need information? Squawk? Read my article when it's published...
strings.저 다니엘, 특종을 쫓는 기자. 특종이라면 어디라도 간다, 간다, 갑니다: I am Daniel, a reporter in pursuit of a scoop. Wherever the story is, I go, go, go! Squawk!
strings.(자신을 다니엘이라고 소개한 앵무새가 행복한 표정을 지으며 목에 건 신분: (The parrot introducing himself as Daniel beams and holds up the identification hanging from his neck.)
strings.혹시 수인이에요?: Are you one of the beastfolk?
strings.잘못 보셨습니다무. 아, 티 내면 안 되는데. 혹시 티 납니까무? 아니,: You've got it wrong, squawk. Ah, mustn't let it show. Can you tell, squawk? I mean, can you tell?
strings.무슨 말인지 전혀 모르겠는데…. 혹시 수인이 아닌 건가요?: I have no idea what you're talking about... So you aren't?
Correct. I am Daniel, formerly of Monthly Rosengarten's editorial department. Squawk.
If you're from Rosengarten in the Demon Realm, obviously...
strings.잠깐, 로젠가르텐을 어떻게 아십니까무?: Wait. How do you know Rosengarten? Squawk?
strings.………다, 당신. 그, 그, 그!! 몽마들을 무참하게 때려잡은 바, 바,: ...Y-you. The one who mercilessly thrashed the dream demons? V-V-Valdrick?!
strings.%s? %s!! 우와악. 그, 그, 그!! 마족에게는 잔혹하지만, 여신에: %s? %s!! Aaaah! Th-the adventurer said to be cruel to demons but kind to the goddess! The adven... adventurer!
strings.살려주세요무! 말하는 앵무새 정도로만 생각해주세요무! 님 말 잘 따라합니: Spare me, squawk! Just think of me as a talking parrot! I'm very good at repeating what you say!
All right, all right. I'll hear you out before I decide.
strings.(마족이 하나도 아니고 둘이나 여기 있다니. 다니엘은 그렇게 위험해 보이: (Two demons here, not just one. Daniel doesn't look very dangerous, though...)
Sigh. Not a single one, squawk...
strings.(다니엘이 한숨을 쉬며 먼 산을 바라본다.): (Daniel sighs and gazes at the distant mountains.)
Invernel may not seem to have any big stories, but I intend to investigate thoroughly.
strings.여기 마족도 있고 별 사람이 다 있으니까 저도 옆마을 앵무 수인으로 위장: There are demons and all sorts of people here. I can disguise myself as a parrot beastperson from the next village. Squawk!
strings.후후, 특종은 기자의 로망 아니겠습니까무!: Hehe. A scoop is every reporter's dream, isn't it? Squawk!
strings.어쩄든 제 취재는 불법이 아닙니다. 레세디아 교단 소속 데미갓 리디아 님: In any case, my reporting is perfectly legal. Lady Lydia, a demigod of the Resedia Order, called me an interesting demon and helped me.
She arranged for the village chief to let me stay. Squawk.
strings.그리고 하급 마족이 나쁜 짓하면 그 자리에서 소멸하는 주문을 거셨습니다무: And she cast a spell that will annihilate this lowly demon on the spot if I do anything wicked. Squawk. I won't, so I'll be fine.
Hehe. I think a reporter who falls in pursuit of a story is admirable, too.
strings.(마족에게 물어봐도 되나…. 로말리우스는 모르겠다고 했는데.): (Should I ask a demon...? Romalius said he didn't know.)
Exchanging information is the foundation of reporting, isn't it? Squawk. I'll tell you what I know.
strings.다니엘, 근처에서 이상한 힘 같은 거 못 느꼈어요? 혹시 마족이라던가?: Daniel, have you sensed any strange power nearby? Or perhaps other demons?
strings.글쎄입니다무. 흐음. 로말리우스 님을 여기서 만나게 된 건 좀 놀랐지만,: Hard to say, squawk. Hmm. Meeting Lord Romalius here surprised me, but nothing apart from that.
strings.사실, 하급 마족이라 큰 힘 같은 건 잘 모릅니다무. 아!: To be honest, as a low-ranking demon, I don't understand great powers very well. Squawk. Oh!
It's off the record, so I'm not sure I can tell you, %s... Squawk...
strings.(다니엘이 배 속에서 들려오는 소리에 놀랐는지 패닉에 빠진다.): (The sound from Daniel's stomach sends him into a panic.)
strings.아, 아…. 인버넬에 와서 아무것도 먹지 못했습니다무. 로말리우스 님도: Ah, ah... I haven't eaten since arriving in Invernel, squawk. Lord Romalius said demons who don't work don't eat. Sniff...
Will you tell me if I give you this? It's jerky, a specialty from another continent...
strings.(다니엘이 %s의 손에 있던 육포를 빼앗아 바로 입에 넣고 뜯기 시작한다: (Daniel snatches the jerky from %s's hand and immediately starts tearing into it.)
strings.별건 아니고, 며칠 전입니다무! 요 앞에서 어디론가 가는 마녀를 봤습니다: Nothing much. A few days ago, squawk! I saw a witch passing through here, squawk! Looking for somewhere to hide!
strings.(어, 혹시 힐다? 숨을 곳을 찾고 있다면 분명…. 역시 이곳에 뭔가 있: (Could it be Hilda? If she was looking for a hiding place... There really must be something here.)
strings.다니엘, 고마워요. 배고픈 거 같은데 이거 다 먹어요. 취재 잘해요. 나: Thank you, Daniel. You look hungry. Have the rest. Good luck reporting. And no mischief.
strings.고맙습니다무, 그런데 어디서 육포가 이렇게 나오는 겁니까무?: Thank you, squawk! But where is all this jerky coming from?
strings.(또 사람들의 움직임이 느려져. 빨리 정보를 모아서 움직이자….): (People are slowing down again. I need to gather information and move quickly...)
strings.언니는 언제 오는 거지?: When will my sister be back?
strings.(사람들의 시선을 사로잡을 정도로 희귀한 머리색을 지닌 소녀가 마을 입구: (A girl with hair so unusual in color that it draws people's eyes watches the village entrance.)
strings.(소녀가 깜짝 놀라 뒤로 물러나다 뭔가에 발이 걸린다. %s 또한 이 상: (Startled, the girl steps back and catches her foot on something. Surprised as well, %s instinctively reaches out and takes her hand before she falls.)
strings.후우, 다행이다. 괜찮아요?: Whew, that was close. Are you all right?
I'm sorry if I startled you.
strings.(소녀가 %s의 손을 잡고 일어나 아무렇지도 않게 행동하려고 한다. 그러: (The girl takes %s's hand and stands, trying to act untroubled. Yet her face is full of alarm.)
I'm Eclair. You can call me Claire. And...
I was trying to think how to introduce myself to someone I've never met...
strings.마음을 가라앉히고 심호흡을 해봐요. 그리고 편안한 생각을 해봐요. 그러면: Calm down and take a deep breath. Think of something comforting. You'll feel better.
Oh, yes... Ah, I really do feel better. Thank you.
I could tell you were no ordinary person. Now that I've heard your name, I understand.
strings.위기에서 사람들을 구하고 있는 모험가가 있다고요. 제국에서도 벌써 소문의: The adventurer who keeps saving people from danger. You're already the talk of the empire...
strings.그렇게 대단한 사람은 아니에요. 그런데 클레어, 세워놓은 건 무기 맞죠?: I'm not that remarkable. But Claire, is that a weapon standing there?
strings.네, 이건 하이랜드를 지켜온 소수 민족 하이랜더만 사용하는 무기, 스파이: Yes. A Spiral Sword, used only by the Highlanders, a people who have long guarded the Highlands.
strings.옛날부터 이곳을 지키기 위해선 강한 무기가 필요했는데, 만들다 보니 이렇: We've always needed powerful weapons to protect this place. Over time, they developed this unusual form.
strings.지금은 비록 극소수만 남아있어서 조금 걱정이에요. 그렇다고 소수 정예로만: There are so few of us left now that I'm worried. But we don't insist on remaining a tiny elite.
strings.위대한 땅과 하늘을 따르는 전사가 되고 싶다면 누구나 환영이에요. 꼭 그: Anyone who wishes to become a warrior following the great earth and sky is welcome. Or simply someone who wants to protect what matters to them.
strings.그래서 제가 종종 찾아오는 사람들의 수련을 돕고 있어요. 저도 수련할 겸: So I help train the people who visit from time to time. It gives me practice too.
Oh, n-no. I still have so much to l-learn.
strings.그런데…, 뭘 물어보려고 하셨던 거죠?: But... What did you want to ask?
strings.혹시 최근에 인버넬 근처에서 수상한 소문 들은 게 있나요? 아니면 이상한: Have you heard any suspicious rumors around Invernel lately? Or has anything strange happened?
There are so many suspicious rumors and strange things, I don't know which to mention.
strings.로말리우스 같은 마족이 마을에 와서 아르바이트하지 않나. 앵무새 수인이: A demon like Romalius comes to the village for part-time jobs. A parrot beastperson turns up to report the news.
strings.…아, 최근에 밖으로 쫓겨난 그리폰들이 인버넬에서 사라져서 종종 트리샤: ...Oh, lately the griffins driven outside have been disappearing from Invernel. Trisha often goes looking for them.
strings.안 그래도 여기 올 때 트리샤와 함께 왔어요. 지금 폐허지대 집터에 있어: I actually came here with Trisha. She's at the site of her house in the Ruins.
strings.아, 다행이다. 고맙습니다, %s 님. 언니도 참 고생이네. 그 많던 그: Oh, thank goodness. Thank you, %s. Trisha works so hard. Where have all those griffins gone?
strings.트리샤 언니가 걱정이에요. 이제 그리폰들 돌보는 사람도 얼마 남지 않았는: I'm worried about Trisha. There are so few people left to care for the griffins...
Try not to worry too much, Claire.
Do I look worried? I'm usually good at hiding my feelings...
You've answered some of my questions, Claire.
strings.다행이에요. 저도 트리샤 언니가 인버넬에 있다고 하니까 걱정하지 않을게요: I'm glad. Knowing Trisha is here in Invernel, I'll try not to worry either. Hehe.
strings.더 궁금한 게 있으시다면 촌장님에게 가보세요. 알렉시스라는 분인데, 절대: If you have more questions, visit the chief. Alexis. Never leaves the area, so you'll find him easily.
Thank you, Claire. I'll look around the village a little more.
Goodbye, %s. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.
strings.(에클레어가 할 일이 있는 듯 어디론가 발걸음을 옮긴다.): (As though she has something to do, Eclair walks away.)
strings.(노르니르의 행복한 시간이란 건 마을 사람들이 쓰는 인사말인가 보네. 다: (That wish for happy time with Nornir must be a local greeting. Everyone uses it...)
strings.(사람들의 움직임이 느려지고 있어. 이것도 시간의 영향일까…. 빨리 정보: (People are slowing down. Is that time's influence too...? I need to gather information and act quickly...)
strings.(인버넬 안전지대를 돌아다니는 동안, 보이는 모든 존재들의 움직임이 느려: (As you explore Invernel's Safe Zone, everyone you see repeatedly slows, then returns to normal.)
strings.(하이랜드 어딘가에 있는 시간의 힘이 뭔가 잘못된 것 같은데….): (Something seems wrong with the power of time somewhere in the Highlands...)
strings.(그럼 잠깐 정리해 볼까….): (Let's take a moment to sort things out...)
strings.(다니엘이 본 마녀는 숨을 곳을 찾아 헤매고 있다고 했고, 에클레어를 비: (Daniel saw a witch looking for somewhere to hide. Eclair and the villagers say the griffins are disappearing.)
strings.(이게 시간의 눈물하고 관련이 있는지는 모르겠네. 후우….): (I don't know if any of it is connected to the Tear of Time. Sigh...)
(Eclair suggested asking the village chief too. I should go.)
strings.(인버넬과는 좀처럼 어울리지 않는 분위기의 청년이 다가오는 사람들을 미소: (A young man whose manner seems out of place in Invernel greets approaching people with a smile.)
strings.(그것도 잠시, 사람들이 물러나자 지친 기색으로 벽에 기댄다.): (As soon as they leave, he leans wearily against the wall.)
strings.(청년이 다가오는 %s의 모습을 보더니 조용히 고개를 돌린다.): (Seeing %s approach, the young man quietly turns his head away.)
strings.(조금 전까지 기운 없이 서 있던 청년이 아무렇지도 않은 듯이 미소를 지: (The young man, who looked so drained a moment ago, smiles at his visitor as though nothing is wrong.)
strings.제가 알렉시스입니다. 촌장님이라고 하기엔 좀 애매하지만…. 그런데, 절: I'm Alexis. Whether 'chief' is quite the right title is debatable... But how did you recognize me?
Claire told me to see Chief Alexis if I had questions.
strings.마을 사람들이 말한 분이군요. 제게 찾아올 정도면 뭔가 중요한 걸 알고: So you're the person the villagers mentioned. If you've come to me, you must want to know something important.
strings.마을 사람들에게 수상한 소문이나 이상한 일 같은 걸 묻고 계시다는 걸 들: I hear you've been asking people about suspicious rumors and unusual events.
Please tell me your name and show any identification you have.
strings.(알렉시스가 %s에게서 서명된 카드를 받아 확인하다가 놀란 표정을 보인다: (Alexis accepts the signed card from %s and looks surprised as he examines it.)
How did you obtain such a precious card? Even the council's nobles rarely receive one...
strings.성함이 %s…. 아, %s 님이시군요. 귀하의 이름은 익히 들어 알고 있: Your name is %s... Ah, so you are %s. I've heard much about you. Unfortunately, from my father's less than favorable remarks...
strings.의회의 귀족들은 황족과 가까운 이들을 좋아하지 않습니다. 적어도 저는 그: The council's nobles dislike those close to the imperial family. Please don't misunderstand. I am different from them, at least.
strings.(그렇다는 건 의회 소속 귀족 집안 사람이란 건데….): (So he comes from a noble family on the council...)
strings.저기, 알렉시스. 그러면 글래스턴에서 오셨어요?: Alexis, are you from Glaston, then?
strings.네, 사정이 있어서요. 아니, 아버지가 하시는 일이 대의에 어긋나는 일이: Yes, due to certain circumstances. No, to be precise, I opposed my father because his actions betrayed a greater cause, and he threw me out.
strings.왜 그런 일을 고집하는 건지, 원…. 부끄러운 일이라 이건 말씀드리지 못: Why he insists on such things... It's shameful, so I can't tell you about it. Sigh...
Just thinking about it exhausts me. I want to rest...
strings.이왕 쫓겨난 거 인버넬로 와서 놀고먹으려고 했는데, 그게 잘 안돼서 촌장: Since I'd been thrown out anyway, I came to Invernel hoping to laze about. Yet somehow I've ended up working so hard as chief!
Forgive me. I meant to mutter that to myself...
It sounds like you've had a difficult time.
strings.그건 그거고, 그래도 맡은 일은 해야겠죠. 인버넬에는 무슨 일로 오셨습니: That aside, I still have a job to do. What brings you to Invernel?
I'm looking for an object. I can't tell you what it is...
strings.괜찮습니다. 저도 말씀 못 드리는 것도 있으니까요. 그러면 제가 아는 선: That's all right. There are things I can't discuss either. Let me think of suspicious rumors or unusual events I know about...
strings.열심히 아르바이트하는 마족이나 앵무새 마족 같은 거 말고 이상한 건 없습: Nothing unusual apart from a demon working hard at part-time jobs and a parrot demon.
strings.특이 사항이라면 최근에 데미갓 한분이 자주 오셨다는 거?: One thing of note is that a demigod has visited frequently lately.
Many demons have appeared recently, so she came to deal with them.
strings.제가 보진 못해서 칼루소 사제님과 이야기하다 보니 폐허지대에 나타난 그레: I didn't see it myself, but Priest Caluso said she caught a demon called a Gremory in the Ruins.
strings.(그레모리 일족? 시간의 힘을 사용하는 마족이 여기 왔다는 건, 여기에: (The Gremory clan? If demons who use the power of time came here, it makes sense that the Tear of Time is nearby.)
I don't know where she went afterward.
I should meet Lady Lydia the demigod later. Then I'll...
strings.(알렉시스와 대화를 끝내려고 하는 순간, 다시 또 보이는 것들이 느리게: (Just as you are about to end the conversation with Alexis, everything in sight begins moving slowly again.)
strings.(느려진 상태가 길어지던 중, 어디선가 동물의 울음소리처럼 들리는 굉음이: (As the slow motion continues, a roar like an animal's cry fills Invernel's Safe Zone.)
strings.(…그 소리로 느려지던 시간이 다시 원래대로 돌아왔어. 이건 어떤 동물의: (...That cry made the slowed time return to normal. What animal was it?)
strings.그리폰들이 또 시끄럽게 우네요. 여기 온 것도 좀 됐는데 전 아직도 적응: The griffins are making a racket again. I've been here a while, but I still need time to adjust. %s?
strings.아, 아니에요. 저 울음소리가 그리폰이라고요?: Oh, nothing. That was a griffin's cry?
strings.네, 소리가 엄청난 걸 보니 대장 그리폰 쯤 되는 거 같네요. 아, 여기: Yes. From the sheer volume, probably a lead griffin. Or 'grippon,' as the children here say?
I'll be going, Alexis. Thank you for talking with me.
Not at all. Hearing that you're leaving is very welcome news.
Haha... If you need help with anything else, try someone other than me. Most people in Invernel are kind.
strings.그러면 노르니르의 행복한 시간이 함께 하시길…. 그런데 왜 난 불행한 시: Then may Nornir bless your time with happiness... Why is my own time so miserable...?
strings.네, 그럴게요. 어, 클레어?: All right, I will. Oh, Claire?
strings.(알렉시스가 환한 얼굴로 벽에 기대 멍하니 서 있을 때, 에클레어가 모험: (As Alexis leans happily against the wall and stares into space, Eclair runs toward the adventurer.)
strings.%s, 여기 계셨네요? 방금 그리폰 울음 소리 들으셨어요?!: %s, here you are! Did you hear that griffin just now?!
Why? Is there something wrong with a griffin calling like that...?
Nothing wrong, but that was Nirvana.
Wait. I was told Nirvana disappeared long ago...
strings.그 소리를 듣고 폐허지대로 가려는데, 로말리우스가 %s 님과 같이 가라면: I was about to go to the Ruins when Romalius told me to go with you, %s. Then he hurried off ahead.
strings.빨리 트리샤 언니 있는 곳으로 가야겠어요. 분명 언니가 니르바나를 찾겠다: We need to get to Trisha. She'll be wandering through the Ruins looking for Nirvana.
I know a shortcut. Follow me.
strings.(에클레어가 언제나 같은 자리에 있는 트리샤의 모습을 확인하더니 서둘러: (Spotting Trisha in her usual place, Eclair hurries toward her.)
strings.다행이긴…. 고마워, 클레어. 내가 며칠 안 보여서 걱정했구나. 미안해,: Thank goodness...? Thank you, Claire. You were worried because I was gone a few days. I'm sorry. I went a little far looking for griffins again.
strings.네, 전 괜찮아요. 그런데, 클레어. 오늘 왜 이렇게 일찍 나왔어?: Yes, I'm fine. But Claire, why are you out so early today?
I thought you might go somewhere dangerous looking for Nirvana...
strings.니르바나? 니르바나 찾는 건 거의 포기했는데, 왜?: Nirvana? I've almost given up looking. Why?
strings.아니, 그게 아니고. 못 들은 거야?: No, that's not it. Didn't you hear?
strings.클레어, 그게 무슨 소리야. 니르바나 울음소리라니. %s, %s도 들으셨: Claire, what are you talking about? Nirvana's cry? %s? %s, did you hear it too?
I heard an animal cry so loudly it shook the village.
strings.트리샤 언니, 기억나? 니르바나의 울음소리가 보통 그리폰하고는 다르다고: Trisha, remember how you said Nirvana's cry was different from other griffins'?
Yes. I studied so hard to tell their calls apart.
strings.그런 언니가 인버넬을 가득 채울 정도로 큰 니르바나의 울음소리를 모를 리: Then there's no way you could miss Nirvana's voice ringing through all of Invernel.
Was it that loud? I couldn't possibly have missed a sound that loud...
strings.(마치 안전지대와 폐허지대가 서로 다른 시공간에 있는 것처럼….): (As though the Safe Zone and the Ruins occupy different times and spaces...)
(Until my situation is resolved, anything could happen. Then...)
Trisha, let's go back to the Safe Zone.
strings.두 사람은 무슨 일이 일어날지 모르니까 잠깐 여기서 기다리세요. 제가 폐: We don't know what might happen, so both of you wait here. I'll take a quick look around the Ruins.
...I can't tell you that much. I'm sorry.
Claire, let's do as %s says. It will only be a moment. We'll wait here.
%s, I'll be here, so we should be safe.
strings.(올라오면서 본 곳 말고 다른 곳부터 찾아봐야겠다. 분명 이상한 장소가: (I'll start somewhere other than the route we took up. There must be something strange...)
strings.(모험가가 떠나자 에클레어가 주위를 살펴본다.): (After the adventurer leaves, Eclair surveys the area.)
strings.이쪽은 작은 그리폰들이 돌아다니는 것 빼고는 이상한 건 없네. 트리샤 언: Nothing unusual here apart from little griffins wandering about. Trisha, is there anything on your side...?
strings.(에클레어가 트리샤에게 말을 걸다 발걸음을 멈추고 앞을 바라본다.): (As Eclair addresses Trisha, she stops and stares ahead.)
(A creature beating tiny wings vigorously circles around Trisha.)
Claire, lower your guard for a moment. I think this cat is trying to tell me something.
strings.(트리샤의 말대로 에클레어가 스파이럴 소드를 쥐고 있던 손을 내린다. 그: (At Trisha's words, Eclair lowers the hand gripping her Spiral Sword. The winged black cat settles on the griffin Salty's head.)
strings.(검은 고양이는 트리샤가 자신을 바라보자 앞발로 허공을 향해 허우적거린다: (When Trisha looks at it, the black cat waves its forepaws in the air.)
strings.주인이 마녀에게 붙잡히지 않으려고 같이 고향을 떠나서 여기 왔는데, 여기: It says it left home with its owner to escape a witch, and they came here. Then they met a demon.
strings.자기 잡으러 온 줄 알고 미리 봐둔 안전한 곳으로 도망쳤는데, 들어간 순: They thought the demon had come to catch them, so they fled to a safe place they'd found. But the moment they entered, its owner vanished, and it became several cats and grew wings.
strings.언니가 그리폰 훈련사니까 그리폰 말을 알아들을 수 있다 쳐. 그런데 고양: I can understand you knowing griffin calls, since you're a trainer. But you understand cats too...?
It says its owner is trapped in Moksha. What was Moksha again...?
strings.언니, 잠깐. 모크샤 그거잖아. 칼루소 사제님이 이야기 해준 위대한 사제: Wait, Trisha. Moksha! It's from that story Priest Caluso told us about a great priest.
strings.옛날에 어떤 사제님이 신비한 힘에 끌려 하이랜드 어딘가 이상한 장소에 들: Long ago, a priest was drawn by a mysterious power into a strange place somewhere in the Highlands. He couldn't find the exit and only escaped ten years later...
strings.(폐허지대를 감싸듯 부드럽게 불어오던 바람이 멈추고, 바람을 따라 걷던: (The breeze that had gently embraced the Ruins stops. Following it, %s naturally comes to a halt as well.)
strings.(지나가는 내내 시야에 인버넬의 부서진 구조물들이 가득했지만, 어느 순간: (Broken Invernel structures had filled your view along the way, but at some point they disappeared. All except one.)
What is this place? There's nothing...
strings.(그 순간, %s의 머리 위로 커다랗고 검은 그림자가 드리운다. 잠시 후: (At that moment, a vast black shadow falls over %s. A moment later, something hanging from it drops to the ground.)
strings.(머리 위 하얀 귀를 쫑긋거리던 소년이 모험가와 눈이 마주치자 불쾌한 표: (A boy with twitching white ears atop his head meets the adventurer's eyes and scowls.)
I was about to ask you the same thing. Wait. El-Larsa definitely...
strings.그래, 나 죽었었어. 그 정령 놈 공격으로. 그런데 그 정령은 여신을 건: Yes, I died. That spirit's attack killed me. But I hear it attacked the goddess and got erased?
strings.위선적이라고 생각하지 않아? 신이 필요해선 만들고, 일만 잔뜩 시키고,: Don't you think it's hypocritical? A god creates something because it's needed, works it to the bone, then destroys it when it's useless.
strings.언젠가는 나를 그렇게 없애 버릴 것 같은 느낌이 들어. 그래도 지금은 아: I have a feeling I'll be erased like that someday. But apparently not yet, since I'm still alive.
What will you do, %s? Fight me here? In this place, you'll...
strings.(노네임의 얼굴에 조소가 피어오른다. 그러자 %s의 시야에 보이는 것들이: (A mocking smile spreads across No Name's face. Everything in %s's view begins to shake.)
strings.(노네임의 말과 함께 시간이 느려지고, 그 순간에 이 상황을 인식한 것: (As No Name speaks, time slows. Seeming to recognize what is happening, he evaporates from view.)
strings.(그리고 그 자리에 다른 인물의 잔상이 나타난다.): (Another figure's afterimage appears in his place.)
strings.(시간이 다시 돌아오는 순간, 흐릿했던 잔상이 선명해진다. 그러자 그 앞: (As time returns to normal, the hazy afterimage sharpens, revealing someone you would rather not meet.)
It's been a while. Judging by your expression, our reunion disappoints you.
strings.여기 참 멋지지 않습니까? 시간이 멈춰 바람조차 사라진 느낌. 그런 의미: A splendid place, isn't it? Time stands still, and even the wind seems to have vanished. Shall we call it the place where the wind rests?
strings.(바르바토스가 안경을 고쳐 쓰며 특유의 조소를 보인다. 그리고 경계하는: (Barbatos adjusts his glasses with his familiar mocking smile, then brushes past the wary %s.)
strings.(모험가가 무기를 들려고 하는 순간, 목으로 어느 때보다 차갑고 날카로운: (As the adventurer reaches for a weapon, the presence of metal, colder and sharper than ever, approaches your throat.)
strings.(그리고 이어 칼날만큼 차가운 여성의 목소리가 들려온다.): (A woman's voice follows, as cold as the blade.)
So you are the servant of the God of the Astral Realm.
strings.대공과 협력하는 관계로서 그의 말을 믿긴 하지만, 이번엔 조금 의심스러웠: As the Grand Duke's ally, I trust his word, but this time I had my doubts.
(The horned woman wears a dry smile that suits her pallid skin.)
Who are you? If you're with the Grand Duke, you must be a demon...
As rude as he said. Addressing me so casually, the queen of the Gremory clan...
strings.(여성이 한숨을 쉬며 %s의 목에 가져다 댄 사이드를 거둔다. 모험가가: (Sighing, the woman withdraws the scythe from %s's throat. The adventurer hurriedly raises a weapon and resumes a defensive stance.)
This is the noble queen of the Gremory clan.
If you must call me something, call me Queen.
The Gremory Queen... The clan that appeared in the sanctuary...
strings.가족이나 다름없던 아이들이 당신에게 쓰러져갔지요. 그래서 언젠가 당신의: Those children were like family to me, and you struck them down. Someday, I would like to hold your life in my hand and toy with it...
strings.인간 주제에 너무 시끄럽군요. 그걸 우리가 말한들, 당신이 뭘 할 수 있: So noisy for a mere human. Even if we told you, what do you think you could do?
strings.내가 이곳의 시간을 살짝 흔들었을 뿐인데, 여기에 나타났다는 건 당신의: I merely disturbed this place's time a little. If that brought you here, your own time must be awry.
You're not denying it. As I thought... Grand Duke.
Allow me to dispose of this human.
There will be time enough after we obtain the Tear of Time.
strings.무슨 말인지 알았어요, 대공. 성계신의 사람에게는 시간을 조금 드리도록: Understood, Grand Duke. I'll grant the Astral Realm's god's servant a little time.
strings.그래도 의미 없는 시간이겠군요. 엉망인 상태의 시간에서 할 수 있는 건: Meaningless time, though. There is little you can do while your time is in such disarray.
strings.퀸, 그래도 조금은 재미있는 쪽이 좋지 않겠습니까?: Queen, wouldn't it be better to make things a little entertaining?
%s, so long as you are here, you have no choice. With that in mind...
strings.(바르바토스가 언제 준비했는지 모를 은화를 허공으로 던진다. 그렇게 은화: (Barbatos tosses a silver coin, produced from nowhere, into the air. As it lands in his hand, %s's vision shakes.)
strings.여전히 당신은 운이 좋군요. 이 시련을 어떻게 견디냐에 따라 목숨을 부지: Your luck holds as ever. Depending on how you endure this trial, you may gain time to remain alive...
strings.(그렇게 앞에서 조소를 보이던 그레모리 퀸과 바르바토스의 모습이 어두운: (Dark shadows swallow the mocking figures of the Gremory Queen and Barbatos, hiding them from view.)
strings.퀸, 모크샤로 가는 입구를 찾았습니까?: Queen, have you found the entrance to Moksha?
Of course, Grand Duke. I found a structure shaped like a doorway.
strings.대공, 칭찬은 고맙지만, 그레모리 일족이 보물을 찾는 건 당연한 거랍니다: Thank you for the compliment, Grand Duke, but finding treasure comes naturally to the Gremory clan.
strings.(이 마족들, 뭐야? 내가 안 보이나?): (What's with these demons? Can't they see me?)
strings.폐허지대 한쪽에 인간이 있는데, 근처에 그리폰이 몰리는 장소가 있을 거예: There is a human in one part of the Ruins, with a place nearby where griffins gather. That's where it is.
strings.(그 다음에 뭐라고 하는 거야? 안 들려….): (What are they saying now? I can't hear...)
strings.(귀 기울여 두 마족의 대화를 집중하려 하지만, 주위의 모든 것이 무언가: (You strain to follow the two demons' conversation, but everything around you seems engulfed by something, and no sound reaches you.)
strings.(잠시 후,아무것도 보이지 않던 %s의 시야에 빛이 다가온다.): (After a while, light approaches %s's darkened vision.)
strings.(이게 무슨 상황이지? 마족들이 없어. 잠깐, 그동안 난 어디 있던 거야: (What happened? The demons are gone. Wait. Where was I all that time? I'm clearly in the same place.)
The Tear of Time must be in Moksha. That's where those two demons went...
(The adventurer hastens behind the statue-like structure and returns to the surrounding Ruins.)
strings.(모험가가 사라진 장소의 하늘 위로 멈춰있던 바람이 불기 시작한다. 그리: (Above the spot where the adventurer vanished, the still wind begins to blow again. An enormous being, previously hidden from view, appears.)
So this is why we postponed the execution. Amusing.
strings.(마도골렘 리카리아와 함께 허공에 떠 있던 그레모리 퀸이 노네임에게 미소: (Floating beside the magic golem Licaria, the Gremory Queen smiles at No Name.)
strings.퀸, 이거 대공 계획이야?: Queen, is this the Grand Duke's plan?
strings.맞아요. 시간의 눈물을 찾는 자가 또 있으니 모크샤에 가두는 편이 좋다면: Yes. Since someone else is seeking the Tear of Time, he thought it best to trap them in Moksha.
strings.모크샤인가 하는 곳, 들어가면 절대 빠져 나올 수 없는 거야?: Once you enter this Moksha place, you can never get out?
strings.날고 긴다 하는 아가슈라의 수장조차도 들어가면 나올 수 있을지 감당할 수: Even the supposedly all-powerful leader of the Agasura could not be certain of escaping once inside. Does that explain it?
If even the leader of the Agasura couldn't...
Well done, No Name. The Grand Duke was right.
That No Name can find doors leading to the gods' realm...
So that's why he came to me.
strings.무슨 말인지 모르겠군요. 노네임과 대공 사이에 일어난 일은 알아서 해결하: I wouldn't know. Settle whatever happened between you and the Grand Duke yourselves...
strings.후후, 노르니르의 눈물 안에서 벌어지는 일은 내게 맡겨요. 어차피 꼬맹이: Hehe. Leave what happens inside the Tears of Nornir to me. A little brat like you won't be able to enter anyway.
strings.시간을 사용할 수 있는 자만 들어갈 수 있는 공간, 노르니르의 눈물이라…: A space only those who can wield time may enter. The Tears of Nornir...
strings.(그레모리 퀸이 눈을 감은 채로 미소를 짓는다.): (The Gremory Queen smiles with her eyes closed.)
I'm very much looking forward to it.
Follow me, Queen. I'll show you the door to the Tears of Nornir.
Trisha, that cat just disappeared, didn't it? R-right here...
Um, Trisha. S-stay calm. I mean...
Claire, get a hold of yourself.
strings.(트리샤가 패닉에 빠진 에클레어의 손을 잡고 흔든다.): (Trisha takes the panicking Eclair's hands and shakes them.)
I must need more training, getting startled by something like this...
strings.혹시 고양이가 사라진 게, 저기 %s 오는 거랑 상관이 있는 걸까?: Could the cat's disappearance have something to do with %s coming over there?
strings.날개 달린 고양이가 날아왔는데, 그게 큰일 아닌가요? 심지어 고양이가 하: A cat with wings flew in. Isn't that serious? And Trisha understood what it said.
That its owner was trapped in Moksha.
strings.트리샤, 혹시 모크샤가 어디에 있는지 아세요?: Trisha, do you know where Moksha is?
Moksha is a place from Highland legends. No one knows where it is.
strings.(어떻게 하지? 맞다. 그리폰이 몰려있는 곳….): (What do I do? Right. Where griffins gather...)
strings.트리샤, 근처에 그리폰이 몰려서 지내는 곳이 있을까요?: Trisha, is there somewhere nearby where griffins live together?
Yes. Shall we go together? Just down there...
strings.트리샤 언니, 내가 %s 님과 같이 거기로 갈게. 여기서 숨어있어. 무슨: Trisha, I'll go with %s. Stay hidden here. We'll come straight back if anything happens.
I think you should do as Claire says, Trisha.
strings.사라졌던 제 그리폰의 울음소리가 여기선 들리지 않았지만, 마을에서는 들리: I couldn't hear my missing griffin here, but I could hear it in the village...
And a winged cat came up and spoke to me...
I don't know enough to give you an answer yet.
Trisha, I think %s is trying to find out, too.
strings.(모든 걸 다 이야기하지 못해서….): (I wish I could tell her everything...)
No, I'm sorry. I shouldn't have put you on the spot like that...
strings.대신 약속할게요. 나쁜 일에 휘말리지 않게, 아니. 나쁜 일이 되지 않도: But I can promise you this. I won't let you get caught up in anything bad. No... I'll make sure nothing bad happens.
Thank you, %s. I'm sure everything will work out.
strings.%s 님, 그리폰들이 몰려있는 곳은 저쪽이에요. 절 따라오세요. 금방 올: %s, the griffins are gathered over there. Follow me. We'll be right back, Trisha.
strings.(쉬느라 정신 없던 그리폰들이 조용히 고개를 들어 앞을 바라본다. 에클레: (The resting griffins quietly raise their heads. Eclair takes out some treats and waves them, catching their attention.)
There's a good flock. Sorry I'm not Trisha.
strings.(에클레어가 있는 힘껏 반대쪽으로 간식을 던지자 그리폰들이 따라 멀리 날: (Eclair throws the treats in the opposite direction with all her strength. The griffins fly off after them.)
That's quite an arm, Claire. Those treats might make it all the way to Luria...
Th-thank you. But I can't throw them q-quite that far.
This angel statue... I've seen a lot of these on the way here.
strings.인버넬에서 흔하게 볼 수 있는 천사 석상이에요. 정교하게 만들어져 진짜: They're common in Invernel. They're so finely carved that people used to say angels must have made them.
strings.다른 천사상은 다 쓰러져 있던 것 같은데, 이것만 제대로 세워져 있네요?: All the others had fallen over, but this one's still standing. Its pose and size are different, too...
strings.(그 순간, %s의 옆을 지나가던 에클레어의 움직임이 느려졌다가 다시 돌: (As Eclair walks past %s, her movements slow, then return to normal.)
strings.(그레모리 퀸이 근처에 있다는 건데…. 어디지? 이 천사상 뒤쪽인가?): (The Gremory Queen must be nearby... Where? Behind this statue?)
strings.천사상은 교단에서 사원을 지으면서 만들었었는데…. %s 님?: The Order made the statues when they built the temple... %s?
strings.(에클레어는 조금 전까지 옆에서 천사상 이야기를 듣던 %s의 모습이 갑자: (Eclair looks around. %s, who was standing beside her listening only a moment ago, has vanished.)
strings.(여전히 보이는 건 기도하는 천사상의 모습과 이곳에서 쉬려고 날아오는 그: (All she can see is the praying angel statue and the griffins flying in to rest.)
Was this... what %s was worried about?
strings.칼루소 사제님에게 빨리 연락해야지…. 아, 맞다. 언니한테 가는 게 먼저: I have to tell Father Caluso... Oh, right. Trisha first.
strings.(에클레어가 서둘러 왔던 곳으로 다시 돌아갔을 때, 어딘가에서 그 모습을: (As Eclair hurries back the way she came, someone who has been watching from hiding quietly emerges.)
To think Moksha would accept you so readily...
strings.당신은 이 세계와는 어울리지 않는 자, 그러니까 오랜 시간동안 모크샤에: You have no place in this world. May Moksha keep you captive for a very, very long time...
strings.(천사상 뒤쪽으로 걸어갔을 뿐인데, 부서진 건물과 석상의 잔해물만이 남았: (A few steps behind the angel statue, the ruined buildings and shattered statues are suddenly gone.)
strings.(그리고 짙은 안개와 이상한 문양이 새겨진 돌 소재의 블록만이 새로운 세: (Only thick fog and stone blocks engraved with strange patterns welcome the visitor to this new world.)
strings.(말도 안 되는 세계의 일부를 가득 채운 것 같은 블록이 꿈틀거리듯 움직: (Blocks fill this impossible world, shifting as though alive.)
strings.(허공에 떠 있는 일부 블록들이 금방이라도 어디론가 날아가 버릴 느낌마저: (Some float in the air, looking as if they might fly away at any moment.)
strings.여기는 대체 어디지? 분명 나는…. 아, 설마 모크샤?: Where am I? I was just... Wait. Is this Moksha?
strings.(언덕 위로 보이는 거대한 그림자가 발을 내디딜 때마다 보이는 모든 것이: (A vast shadow looms over a hill. Each of its footsteps shakes everything in sight, sending the stacked blocks crumbling, scattering, or soaring into the sky.)
strings.(뭔지 알 수 없는 존재를 피해 들어왔던 곳으로 가려고 하지만, 길이란: (Trying to escape the unknown creature, the adventurer turns back toward the entrance, but can find no path.)
strings.(그저 이상한 문양들이 새겨진 블록만이 여기저기 흩어져 다른 길을 만들: (Only scattered blocks covered in strange patterns, endlessly forming new paths.)
strings.여기서 어떻게 가야 하는 거지? 시간의 눈물이 여기 있긴 한 거야? 응?: How am I supposed to get anywhere? Is the Tear of Time even here? Hm?
strings.(그런 그때, 옷깃이 어딘가에 걸린 것 같은 느낌이 들어 뒤를 돌아보니: (Feeling a tug on their clothes, the adventurer turns to find someone standing behind them.)
strings.(고양이 귀처럼 생긴 모자를 쓰고, 고양이가 그려진 커다란 여행용 가방의: (A girl in a cat-eared hat holds the handle of a large suitcase decorated with a cat. She raises a hand in greeting, almost like a salute.)
What are you doing here? This place...
strings.(레피카라고 소개한 소녀가 한숨을 내쉰다. 그리고 허리에 있던 가방에서: (The girl who introduced herself as Lepica sighs. She takes a potion from the pouch at her waist and offers it to %s.)
Lepica's Alien Red is great for digestion, and it keeps you full when you're hungry.
strings.이거 엄청 좋은 건데. 아니면 다른 거 줄까? 프리링 그린 어때? 자,: It's really good stuff. Or would you like something else? How about Priring Green? Go on, take it.
strings.포션 이름이 에일리언 레드, 프리링 그린…. 왜 다 그런 거죠?: Alien Red? Priring Green? Why do all your potions have names like that?
strings.그런데 넌 누구야? 누군데 여기 들어온 거야?: But who are you? What brought you here?
My name is %s. I heard there was something here...
strings.%s, %s? 네 이름 어디서 들어본 것 같은데…. 그냥 편하게 우리 이: %s... %s? I feel like I've heard your name before... Anyway, no need to be so formal.
Whatever you heard, %s, there's no Tear of Time here.
strings.난 1주일 동안 괴물의 눈을 피해서 나갈 곳을 찾았어. 시간의 눈물 같은: I've spent a week hiding from the monster and looking for a way out. If there were anything like a Tear of Time, I'd have seen it.
strings.아, 괴물에게 잡히면 안 돼. 날 쫓아 들어온 여자가 있었는데. 괴물의: Oh, don't let the monster catch you. A woman followed me in here. It grabbed her and crushed her to dust.
But this isn't the safe place I thought it was.
strings.안전한 곳? 왜 쫓기고 있었어?: Somewhere safe? Why were you being chased?
strings.아냐, 나는 평범한 엘프…. 아, 진짜!: No, I'm an ordinary elf... Oh, come on!
strings.나는 사람들이 생각하는 그런 나쁜 마녀 아냐!: I'm not one of those evil witches everyone talks about!
Lepica, I didn't come here to hurt a witch.
strings.(레피카가 두 손으로 여행용 가방을 들어 힘차게 휘두른다. 아무리 말려보: (Lepica grips her suitcase with both hands and swings it wildly. No amount of reassurance seems to calm her.)
strings.내 눈앞에서 마녀라는 이유만으로 다 죽었어…. 그냥 특별했을 뿐인 사람들: They all died right in front of me, just because they were witches... They were people who happened to be different! I never even wanted to become a witch...
Why did a black moon have to rise over my peaceful nights...?
