strings.(레피카가 한숨을 쉬고 다시 가방을 바닥에 내려둔다.): (Lepica sighs and sets her suitcase down again.)
strings.미안해. 아…. 이제 생각났어. 네 이름을 어디서 들어본 것 같다고 했잖: I'm sorry. Oh... Now I remember. I said I'd heard your name before, didn't I? Hilda told me.
She said if I ever met %s, you'd help me. That someone dear to a god would help me.
strings.힐다를 알아? 지금 힐다는 어디 있어?: You know Hilda? Where is she now?
Yes. Hilda's my friend. She came to me one day, needing somewhere to hide. She told me the night had begun.
strings.한동안 안 보이다가 내가 숨은 곳을 찾아서 또 도망가라고 했는데…. 정작: I didn't see her for a while, but then she found my hiding place and told me to run again... I don't know where she is now.
I told her to come back whenever she wanted to see Nero...
strings.내가 키우는 패밀리어 고양이야. 그런데 어디 간 거지? 네로, 네로!!: My cat familiar. Where did he go, anyway? Nero! Nero!
strings.(레피카가 누군가의 이름을 부르자 모크샤의 하늘 여기저기서 날개달린 고양: (At Lepica's call, winged cats flock down from all over Moksha's sky.)
strings.으아아아아악! 하나씩 오라고! 수십 마리가 한꺼번에 오지 말라고! 왜 이: Aaaaah! One at a time! Don't all come at once! Why did you split into dozens of cats the moment we got here?
strings.(날개 달린 고양이? 트리샤가 말했던 고양이 같은데….): (Winged cats? They look like the one Trisha described...)
strings.(네로라 불린 고양이는 아랑곳하지 않고 레피카에게 다가가 온 몸을 비비기: (The cats called Nero ignore her and start rubbing against her. All dozens of them.)
strings.네로, 이 바보야! 나 오늘 아직 알러지 약도 안 먹은 상태라고!!: Nero, you idiot! I haven't taken my allergy medicine today!
strings.(레피카의 재채기와 함께 놀란 고양이들이 도망치듯 허공으로 떠오른다. 하: (Startled by Lepica's sneezing, the cats scatter into the air. But they soon come back, determined to snuggle into her arms.)
strings.으아아악, 네로! 뭐 하는 짓이야? 갈 곳이 있다고? 여기선 안된다고?: Aaaaah, Nero! What are you doing? We need to go somewhere? We can't do it here?
strings.(네로 수십 마리가 레피카를 붙잡고 허공으로 날아오른다.): (Dozens of Neros grab Lepica and lift her into the air.)
strings.네로? 네로! 레피카를 어디로 데려가는 거야?!: Nero? Nero! Where are you taking Lepica?!
strings.(냐옹, 냐옹 거리는 소리가 모크샤를 가득 채울 정도로 시끄럽다.): (The chorus of meows is loud enough to fill all of Moksha.)
strings.%s, 네로가 모크샤를 나갈 방법을 찾았대. 1주일 동안 헤매도 못 찾은: %s, Nero found a way out of Moksha! He found what I've spent a whole week looking for!
strings.어떻게 해야 하는데…?: What do we need to do...?
strings.…이 지긋지긋한 알러지. 후우, 여기선 안 되고. 잠깐, 네로 이야기 좀: ...These blasted allergies. Phew. We can't do it here. Wait, let me listen to Nero. Huh? We have to do that?
strings.저기, %s. 방법을 들어보니까 괜찮은 거 같아. 내가 바로 계획을 세웠: Hey, %s. His idea sounds pretty good. I've already come up with a plan...
If Nero bothers you, just put up with it, okay? Don't get angry.
strings.(그러자 네로 수십 마리가 날아와 %s의 시야를 가린다.): (Dozens of Neros fly over and block %s's view.)
strings.뭐, 뭐야? 다, 다가오는 건 좋은데 입에 털 좀 안 묻게…. 어?: Wh-what? I don't mind you coming over, but please keep your fur out of my mouth... Huh?
strings.(시야를 가린 고양이들이 다시 날아올라 사라졌을 때쯤, 허공에서 네로들에: (By the time the cats fly away and clear the view, Lepica is gone from where the other Neros were holding her.)
strings.레피카? 레피카? 어디 갔어? 네로, 레피카를 어디로 데려간 거야? 아악: Lepica? Lepica, where are you? Nero, where did you take her? Aagh!
strings.(그 순간, 많은 네로들이 서로 약속이라도 한 것처럼 공격하기 위해 날아: (At that moment, a swarm of Neros swoops in to attack, as though acting on a signal.)
strings.네로가 귀찮게 해도 참으라는 소리가 이런 거였나…. 방법이 있긴 한 건가: So this is what she meant by putting up with Nero... Does she really have a plan?
strings.어쩔 수 없지. 레피카를 믿는 수밖에. 일단 가보자. 가보면 어떻게든 될: I don't have much choice. I'll have to trust Lepica. Let's keep moving. Something will work out.
strings.하아, 하아. 좀 쉬어도 될까?: Haah... Haah... Can I take a break?
strings.힘들겠다. 그런데 쉴 틈이 없는데, 어쩌지?: You must be worn out. But we don't have time to rest...
I know this sounds ridiculous, but I don't think it'll work if you stop.
Yes. He heard it from a friend he met outside.
strings.네로가 모크샤에 들어와서 분열됐는데, 특별한 능력이 생겼어. 내가 여기: Nero split into all these cats when we entered Moksha, but he got a special ability, too. He can come and go as he likes, even while I'm stuck here.
He's been talking to people and his animal friends, looking for a way out.
strings.(아, 그래서 트리샤 앞에 나타난 거였나. 그런데 동물친구?): (So that's why he went to Trisha. But an animal friend...?)
strings.그리폰 대장에게 모크샤에서 나가는 방법을 물어봤더니 어떤 힘이든 거대한: He asked the griffin leader how to leave Moksha. It said we have to unleash an enormous amount of energy, whatever kind we can, and shake Moksha itself.
strings.게다가 욕심도, 쓸데없는 생각도 모두 버리고 해야 한대. 왜 그런 방법이: And we have to let go of all our desires and stray thoughts while we do it. What kind of solution is that? Ugh...
I came here to try it safely on my own, but I couldn't make it work.
strings.혹시 몰라서 다른 계획도 세웠는데, 그 계획에 너도 있었어. 내가 화내지: I had a backup plan, though. One that involved you. Remember when I told you to put up with Nero?
strings.지금 이 안에서 저기 보이는 괴물을 제외하고 여길 흔들 수 있는 힘을 가: Other than that monster over there, we're probably the only ones here strong enough to shake this place.
strings.자, 잠깐. 레피카. 그래서 어떻게 하자고요?: W-wait, Lepica. What exactly are you suggesting?
I don't like it either, but let's put everything else aside and focus on getting out.
strings.(레피카가 가방에서 다양한 포션을 꺼내 손가락 사이에 끼운다.): (Lepica takes several different potions from her bag and slips the bottles between her fingers.)
strings.너와 내 힘을 부딪쳐서 모크샤를 흔들어야 해. 그게 원치 않는 싸움이라고: We have to clash our powers together to shake Moksha. Even if neither of us wants to fight. We can't stay trapped here forever, never getting to do the things we want.
If it's our only way out, then we don't have a choice. I'll do it. I'll try.
strings.날 믿어. 내 실력은 확실하니까. 그러면 간다!: Trust me. I know what I'm doing. Here goes!
strings.(레피카가 가방에 손을 집어넣고 이리저리 휘젓는다. 깜짝 놀라 열어보니: (Lepica rummages in her suitcase. Startled, she opens it wide. Only two potions remain.)
strings.레피카, 시간이 없어. 빨리 해야해. 괴물이 다가오는 속도가 더 빨라졌어: Lepica, we're running out of time. Hurry! The monster's getting faster.
strings.…알았어. 그런데 어쩌지?: ...I know. But what do we do?
Don't worry, Lepica. We've done everything we can. It'll work out...
All right. You trusted me just as I trusted you. I'll put my faith in this moment.
strings.(점점 괴물의 모습이 가까워지고, 두 사람 앞에 선 순간, 괴물이 팔을: (The monster draws closer. Towering over them, it raises an arm to smash the ground.)
strings.(포션 병이 열리던 순간, 어디선가 마을에서 들었던 커다란 그리폰의 울음: (As the potion bottles open, the great griffin's cry heard in the village echoes from somewhere beyond.)
strings.(하지만, 그것과는 상관없이 %s의 공격이 강한 마력을 품은 채로 흘러나: (At that same moment, %s's attack strikes the flowing potion, charged with powerful magic.)
strings.(보라색 포션 용액이 강한 힘에 반응해 커다란 소리와 함께 하늘로 솟아오: (The purple liquid reacts to the force, bursting skyward with a thunderous roar. It explodes like fireworks, filling all of Moksha.)
strings.(그리고 조금씩 멀리 보이는 안개를 지워간다.): (Little by little, the distant fog begins to clear.)
strings.마, 말도 안돼. %s, 저기 보여? 보여?: I-I don't believe it! %s, do you see that? Do you see it?
strings.(안개가 개이면서 두 사람이 있던 곳으로 다가오던 괴물의 모습이 흐려진다: (As the fog clears, the approaching monster begins to fade. Through it, the ruins slowly come into view.)
strings.이런 상황에서 그런 멘트를 하면 안된다는 거 몰라? 그런 소리 하면 다시: Don't you know you're never supposed to say that at a time like this? Say that, and it'll come back—
strings.(그 말과 함께 진짜로 사라져가던 괴물이 어떻게든 다시 움직이기 시작한다: (As if on cue, the fading monster struggles into motion again.)
strings.(레피카가 멍하니 있다가 네로의 앞발에 머리를 얻어 맞는다.): (Lepica stands stunned until Nero swats her on the head.)
strings.아악, 아프다고!! 너 자꾸 무능한 마녀라고 할래? 닥치고 자기 말 들으: Ow! That hurts! Will you stop calling me a useless witch? Shut up and listen to you? How do we get out?
strings.(그 말이 끝나기 무섭게 네로 수십 마리가 다가와 두 사람을 붙잡고 하늘: (Before she has finished speaking, dozens of Neros sweep in, grab them both, and haul them into the sky.)
strings.안개가 다시 피어나고 있어!! 꽉 붙잡아!: The fog's coming back! Hold on tight!
strings.(앙칼진 고양이 울음소리와 함께 일행은 모크샤의 안개를 헤치고 폐허지대로: (With a chorus of piercing meows, they fly through Moksha's fog toward the sky above the ruins.)
strings.(아무것도 들리지 않고, 아무것도 보이지 않는다. 그리고 신체의 어떤 부: (There is nothing to hear, nothing to see. No part of the body will move.)
strings.(정신은 살아있지만, 제대로 깨어나지 못하는 상태인 것 같다. 그때 어디: (Consciousness lingers, but waking seems impossible. Then a peculiar sound cuts through the haze.)
strings.(이 소리는…. 그런데, 얼굴에 뭐가 올라온 거지? 왜 이렇게 무거운거야: (That sound... And what's on my face? Why is it so heavy? What... What happened to me?)
Nero, don't sit on people's faces.
strings.(손을 뻗어 얼굴에 있는 걸 붙잡고 뗀 순간, 아무것도 보이지 않던 세계: (A hand reaches up and lifts the weight away. Light slowly returns to the sightless world.)
strings.정신이 드냐고?: Am I awake now, you ask?
Wait, Nero. You've been sitting on my face this whole...
strings.(네로를 들어 옆으로 밀치던 중, 누워있던 모험가를 바라보는 세 소녀의: (Moving Nero aside, the adventurer sees three girls looking down at them.)
You've got Nero's fur in your mouth.
Trisha, %s seems all right. They're even talking to the cat.
strings.그건 나도 마찬가지였잖아. 네로, %s 정신 없으니까 이리 올래?: So was I, remember? Nero, %s is still a little dazed. Come here, will you?
strings.(네로가 트리샤와 눈을 맞추더니 날아서 품 안으로 파고든다.): (Nero meets Trisha's eyes, then flies into her arms.)
Nero, don't forget whose familiar you are. Your wings haven't gone away, though...
strings.네로, 내가 날개 없애줄까? 아악, 날개가 맘에 들면 드는 거지. 왜 주: Should I get rid of them for you? Ow! If you like your wings, just say so! Why hit your owner?
strings.레피카, 정말 모크샤에 있었던 거예요?: Lepica, were you really in Moksha?
Yes. Thanks to %s, Nero and I got out.
I thought it was just a legend. I can't believe it's a real place.
Claire, the world is full of unbelievable things.
strings.세 사람, 벌써 인사했나 보네요. 서로 이름을 다 알고 있고. 아, 그런: I see you've already introduced yourselves. You all know each other's names. But why was I lying here?
You fell out of the sky.
strings.갑자기 네로가 하나가 되는 거야. 우리 무게를 견딜 수 없는지 그냥 놓아: All of a sudden, Nero turned back into one cat. Apparently he couldn't carry us, so he just let go. Heartless little creature.
Ahaha... So that's how you got knocked out...
Phew... You'd think I'd be used to it by now, but it never gets any easier.
What sort of things do you get up to...?
strings.(그 순간, 인버넬 폐허지대를 가득 채울 정도로 커다란 그리폰의 울음소리: (At that moment, a griffin's tremendous cry fills the Invernel Ruins.)
strings.(놀란 트리샤가 자신도 모르게 안고 있던 네로를 떨어뜨릴 뻔 한다. 다행: (Startled, Trisha nearly drops Nero. Fortunately, he flaps his wings and takes flight.)
...Nirvana? That's Nirvana. That's how he used to call for me.
strings.(그리운 존재의 이름을 부르던 트리샤의 눈가에 눈물이 맺힌다. 그걸 보던: (Tears well in Trisha's eyes as she speaks the name she has missed so dearly. Nero quietly licks them away.)
strings.네로, 저거 대장 그리폰이지?: Nero, that's the griffin leader, isn't it?
strings.노르니르의 눈물로 들어가는 문이 열렸다, 성계신의 사람이 빨리 와야 한다: The door to the Tears of Nornir is open. The one who serves the God of the Astral Realm must hurry... ?
Trisha should go home with Claire...? It's Nirvana, isn't it? Nirvana...
So the griffin leader's name is Nirvana.
strings.설마 했는데…. 이제야 트리샤 언니가 저 울음소리를 들을 수 있다는 게: I thought it might be... But it's strange that Trisha can only hear him now.
It's as if time and space have fallen out of step.
strings.%s, 네가 여기 온게 그거 때문이지? 네가 찾는 게 저쪽에 있는 것 같: %s, that's why you're here, isn't it? What you're looking for must be over there. Nirvana is calling for you.
Nero and I should be going.
strings.두 사람은 니르바나 말대로 마을로 돌아가. 여기 있으면 위험할 거야. 생: You two should go back to the village, like Nirvana said. It won't be safe here. Things are happening that none of us expected.
strings.(네로가 앞발로 크게 동그라미를 그린다.): (Nero draws a large circle with his front paws.)
strings.…난 아직도 모르겠어. 하지만, 그렇다고 해서 이대로 여기서 있을 수는: ...I still don't understand. But I can't just stay here. I'll go back and find a way to protect the village.
strings.마을은 괜찮을 거야. 네로가 그러는데, 그들은 원하는 걸 얻으면 바로 이: The village should be fine. Nero says they'll leave as soon as they get what they want...
Hmm... Well, that's a relief, at least...
Claire, let's go back. All we can do for now is wait in the village.
strings.마녀가 없는 곳. 그게 어딘지는 모르겠지만, 안전한 곳이 있겠지. 그렇다: Somewhere without witches. I don't know where that is, but there must be somewhere safe. I can't keep hiding here forever.
I do know one safe place.
strings.성역 에이도스 관문에 여신상이 하나 있을 거야. 그 앞에서 힐다 친구인데: There's a goddess statue at the Eidos Sanctuary Gateway. Stand before it and say you're Hilda's friend, that %s sent you, and that you need somewhere safe.
Then you'll be taken to the safe place where Hilda stayed.
I'll repay you twice over someday.
strings.그러면 안녕, 모두들 안녕. 나중에 또 만나는 거다. 내가 안전한 날이: Then goodbye! Goodbye, everyone. We'll meet again, okay? Once it's safe for me, I'll bring Nero to visit the Invernel Safe Zone. I promise.
All right, Lepica. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.
strings.조심해서 가. 네가 안전하길 바랄게. 진짜 놀러 오고…. 레피카, 노르니: Take care. I hope you'll be safe. And do come visit... Lepica, may Nornir bless your time with happiness.
strings.웅, 나…. 이렇게 행복을 빌어주는 사람 처음이야…. 나도 노르니르 좋아: Mm... No one's ever wished me happiness like that before... I like Nornir, too. May you have Nornir's happiness. Mm.
strings.(레피카가 훌쩍거리자 네로가 뛰어올라 뒷발로 찬다.): (As Lepica sniffles, Nero jumps up and kicks her with his hind legs.)
Nero, could you please stop kicking your owner to make her pull herself together?
Take care, everyone. And %s, finish what you came to do and stay safe, all right?
strings.(레피카가 기지개를 키며 활짝 웃는다. 그리고는 가방에서 한 개 남은 분: (Lepica stretches and beams. She takes one remaining pink potion from her suitcase and pours it onto the ground.)
strings.(잠시 후, 포션이 뿌려진 자리에 네레이스 관문에서 봤었던 게이트 같은: (A moment later, a structure like the gate at the Nereis Gateway rises from the spot.)
strings.마침 이 포션이 남아있어서 다행이야. 그러면 진짜 안녕, 안녕!: Good thing I still had this one. All right, goodbye for real this time! Bye!
(Lepica gives a salute in farewell and hurries through the gate with Nero. The instant she enters, it vanishes without a trace.)
strings.마법도 아니고 신기한 능력이 있는 걸 보면 레피카는 그런 부류의 사람인가: That wasn't magic, but she has such strange powers... Do you think Lepica might be one of those people?
strings.%s, 저는 클레어와 함께 마을로 돌아가서 기다리고 있을게요. 나쁜 일이: %s, Claire and I will wait for you in the village. You promised nothing bad would happen. Please keep that promise.
strings.%s 님, 나중에 기회가 된다면 상황을 이야기해 주세요. 지금은 조금 답: %s, tell us what's going on when you get the chance. It's a little frustrating being in the dark.
strings.이 시간에는 항상 칼루소 사제님이 저쪽을 순찰하고 계실 거예요. 저쪽에서: Father Caluso usually patrols over there at this hour. He says he sometimes senses a faint holy power from that direction.
strings.고마워요. 트리샤, 클레어. 그러면 저도…. 두 분에게 노르니르의 행복한: Thank you, Trisha. Claire. Then let me say it, too... May Nornir bless your time with happiness.
(Eclair and Trisha answer %s's blessing with bright smiles, then hurry back to the village.)
Time to get back to work. They said it was over there.
Let's go find the Tear of Time.
strings.(단정한 사제복을 입었지만, 왠지 모르게 불량해 보이는 남자가 턱을 긁적: (A man in neat priestly robes scratches his chin and surveys his surroundings. Something about him looks decidedly disreputable.)
strings.로말리우스가 알바하던 것도 멈추고 뛰어온 걸 보면 분명 근처에 있는데,: Romalius left his work and came running, so there must be something nearby. But I can't see a thing.
strings.로말리우스, 좀 더 집중했으면 좋겠어. 수고해 준 만큼, 따로 교단에 청: Try to concentrate a little harder, Romalius. I'll bill the Order separately for your trouble. Though you'll have to forgive the delay in payment.
strings.(칼루소가 콧수염을 잡아당기며 가볍게 웃는다.): (Caluso tugs at his mustache and chuckles.)
strings.유능한 인재를 무급으로 다룰 수야 없지. 후후, 어차피 내 돈도 아니니까: I can't expect talented people to work for free. Heh. Besides, it's not my money.
Father Caluso, you have a truly frightening face.
strings.마족에게서 그런 소리 듣기 싫소만. 실없는 소리는 그만하고 뭔가 느껴진: I don't care to hear that from a demon. Enough nonsense. Do you sense anything?
strings.…희미하지만 저쪽에 엄청난 마력이 느껴지는군. 보통 마족이 아닌 것 같은: ...It's faint, but there's an immense magical presence over there. That doesn't feel like an ordinary demon...
Could this have something to do with %s's arrival?
strings.없다고는 할 수 없겠지. 그리폰도 제 말하면 온다더니, 저기 당사자가 오: I wouldn't rule it out. Speak of the griffin and it appears. Here comes our adventurer now.
strings.그런데, 로말. 그런 말은 어디서 배웠지? 하이랜드엔 그런 말이 없는데…: Romal, where did you learn that saying? We don't say that in the Highlands...
strings.로말리우스. 여기 있었어요? 옆에 계신 분은 칼루소 사제님?: Romalius, there you are. And you must be Father Caluso?
strings.레세디아의 최고 사제로서 요청할게 있습니다. 신분을 증명할 게 있으십니까: As High Priest of Resedia, I must ask you to verify your identity. Do you have any identification?
strings.제 인상이 원래 이러니 다른 오해는 하지 않으셔도 됩니다. 간혹 무서운: Please don't take my expression the wrong way. This is simply how I look. People sometimes find me intimidating.
strings.(칼루소가 %s의 손에 있는 황실 인증 카드를 보더니 감탄한다.): (Caluso looks at the imperial authorization card in %s's hand with admiration.)
strings.황성과 교단에서 인정한 %s 님…. 확인했습니다. 저는 칼루소, 세레스: %s, recognized by the imperial court and the Order... Everything is in order. I am Caluso, High Priest of the Resedia Order, also known as the Order of Seres.
strings.제 입으로 최고라고 소개하려니 조금 민망하군요. 하하. 지금은 최고가 아: It feels a little embarrassing to call myself a High Priest. Haha. These days, I'm more helpless than high-ranking.
strings.마족과의 전투에서 너무 많은 신성력을 잃고 말았습니다. 제 능력이 부족했: I lost a great deal of my holy power fighting demons. My own inadequacy was to blame.
strings.하하, 어디 아프거나 힘들거나 그런 건 아닙니다. 다만, 대규모의 전투에: Haha, I'm not ill or in pain. I only regret that I can no longer take part in major battles.
The days of Caluso, the Mad Battle Priest, are behind me...
strings.아, 쓸데없는 이야기가 길었습니다. 그러면 바로 본론으로 들어갈까요?: Ah, I've gone on long enough. Shall we get to the matter at hand?
strings.지금 제가 %s 님께서 이리스 님을 돕는 일을 하고 있다고 생각하면 되겠: Am I correct in understanding that you are working to help Iris, %s?
Yes... That's close enough, I think.
strings.(그런 그때, 눈앞에 있던 칼루소와 로말리우스의 움직임이 느려졌다 다시: (Caluso and Romalius suddenly slow down, then return to normal. It happens several more times.)
strings.로말리우스도 느꼈군. %s 님은 어떠십니까?: You felt it too, Romalius. And you, %s?
You both felt something? Right now, time around me is...
Both of you, come over here a moment.
strings.(로말리우스가 부른 장소로 다가가자 모크샤 입구와 비슷한 형태의 돌로된: (Where Romalius stands is a stone doorway, much like the entrance to Moksha.)
strings.오래전 교단에서 인버넬 이곳저곳에 세운 돌문입니다. 그런데, 여기는 확실: The Order erected stone gates all over Invernel long ago. But there's definitely something different about this one.
strings.(칼루소가 문 앞에 떨어진 뭔가를 발견하고 손에 쥔다.): (Caluso picks up something lying before the gate.)
A black fragment shaped like a butterfly...
Similar to the Grand Duke's, but not his. That heavy scent of greed...
The Gremory Queen is here. She assisted the Grand Duke in the Demon Realm, too.
strings.잠깐, 대공이라면 바르바토스 말하는 건가? 게다가 그레모리 퀸이 왜 여기: Wait. By the Grand Duke, you mean Barbatos? And what's the Gremory Queen doing here...?
strings.그레모리 일족의 능력을 알고 있으면 말이 안 되는 건 아니지. 설마, %: Given the Gremory clan's powers, it's not impossible. Could that be why you've come, %s...?
strings.시간의 영역에 들어가기 위해서…?: To enter the realm of time...?
strings.칼루소 사제도 둘을 알고 있어?: You know them both, Father Caluso?
Indeed I do. I know less of the Gremory Queen, but the Grand Duke and I...
strings.언젠가 옛날 교황께서 전쟁이 있던 시기 피난민과 함께 이곳에 오셨을 때,: Long ago, during a war, a former pontiff came here with a group of refugees and discovered a strange place.
strings.그리고 그곳에서 무슨 일이 일어났는지는 모르지만, 밖으로 나와 그곳을 봉: No one knows what happened inside, but he is said to have sealed it after emerging.
strings.아마도 지금 마족들의 힘이 느껴지는 곳, 바로 여기가 그 장소인 것 같습: I suspect this place, where we can now sense the demons' power, is the very same. Are you sure you wish to proceed?
There's something I have to put right.
strings.알겠습니다. 한 가지만 확인하겠습니다. 시간의 흐름을 느끼셨습니까?: Understood. One more thing: have you felt the flow of time?
Yes. Just now, I felt time distort, the same as you both did.
If the Gremory Queen entered, there must be a divine treasure inside connected to time.
strings.내가 보기에 그 보물이 필요한 건 대공 같지만, 분명 퀸은 그 보물을 보: I suspect the Grand Duke is the one who needs it. But the moment the Queen sees that treasure, she'll claim it for herself.
It's simply her nature. The Grand Duke knows it, too.
strings.그러면 알면서도 보물을 찾으라고 안에 들어가게 했다는 건가?: And he sent her in to find the treasure, knowing that?
We'll have to see for ourselves, Father Caluso. For now, it's only my guess.
strings.예상치고 너무 잘 들어맞는데. 역시 훌륭한 인재야. 교단에 시급을 올려달: A remarkably convincing guess. You really are a valuable asset. I'll have to ask the Order to raise your hourly rate.
If the Queen's that dangerous, I can't afford to wait here.
strings.옛 교황께서 시간의 영역에서 나오신 후, 오래 지나지 않아 영면하신 건: The former pontiff passed away not long after leaving the realm of time. The distorted time had taken its toll on him.
strings.그래서 언젠가 나중에 들어가게 되는 위대한 자를 위해 기도문을 남기셨습니: So he left a prayer for the great soul who would one day enter after him.
strings.레세디아 교단의 최고 사제로서 기도문을 읊도록 하겠습니다. 노르니르의 눈: As High Priest of the Resedia Order, I shall recite it. I never imagined I would meet someone bound for the Tears of Nornir...
strings.노르니르의 눈물…, 멋진 이름이군. 그런데 노르니르가 뭐지?: The Tears of Nornir... A fine name. But what is Nornir?
The collective name for the gods who preside over past, present, and future.
strings.(칼루소가 조용히 눈을 감은 채 %s의 어깨에 손을 올려놓는다.): (Caluso closes his eyes and rests a hand on %s's shoulder.)
strings.노르니르의 시간이여. 시간의 노르니르여. 낮과 밤, 해와 달, 어제와 오: O time of Nornir. O Nornir of time. Day and night, sun and moon, yesterday, today, and tomorrow. May happiness fill the time you hold within you.
strings.(기도를 이어가던 칼루소의 앞으로 알 수 없는 빛이 피어오른다.): (As Caluso continues his prayer, a mysterious light blooms before him.)
Father Caluso. It seems Nornir has answered.
strings.(칼루소가 눈을 떠 앞을 바라봤을 때, 문 앞에 마법 게이트 같은 장막이: (Caluso opens his eyes. A veil resembling a magical portal stretches across the doorway.)
The light reached out and took them inside. As if something within was pulling them in.
strings.그 빛이 노르니르였다면 좋겠군. 돕고 싶지만, 이렇게 우린 들어가는 것조: I hope that light was Nornir. I wish we could help, but we're not even permitted to enter.
strings.…일단 여기서 기다리자고. 대공이 어딘가에서 여길 지켜보고 있을지도 모르: ...Let's wait here for now. The Grand Duke may be watching from somewhere.
strings.이런 식으로 다시 보는 건 별론데, 후우. 일단 리디아가 가까운 곳에 있: I'd rather not meet him again under these circumstances. Phew. I'll send Lydia a message and see if she's nearby.
strings.(칼루소의 기도문이 이어지던 중, 갑자기 들려오는 그리폰의 울음소리가 폐: (As Caluso recites his prayer, a sudden griffin's cry shakes the ruins.)
strings.(흔들린 건 %s 뿐만이 아니었다. 악의가 가득한 자의 날카로운 사이드가: (It is not only %s who is shaken. A malicious foe's sharp scythe misses its mark and strikes the floor.)
strings.(그레모리 퀸이 일부러 놀란 척하며 모험가를 바라본다.): (The Gremory Queen regards the adventurer with feigned surprise.)
strings.대공 말대로 당신은 운이 좋군요. 분명 죽음이 코 앞이었을 텐데, 이렇게: You are lucky, just as the Grand Duke said. Death was right before your eyes, yet somehow you slipped past it. How curious.
Almost as if you'd entrusted your life to that griffin...
strings.(그레모리 퀸이 뭔가 알았는지 가볍게 미소를 짓는다. 그리곤 떨어진 사이: (A knowing smile crosses the Gremory Queen's face. She lifts her fallen scythe with ease.)
strings.신들이 흘린 눈물, 그 눈물이 묻힌 시간의 영역. 여기가 바로 당신과 내: The tears shed by gods, buried within the realm of time. Here lies what we both seek.
strings.(주위를 둘러보자 조금 전까지 앞에 있던 칼루소와 로말리우스의 모습이 보: (Looking around, the adventurer finds Caluso and Romalius gone. The ruined landscape, with Invernel Temple in the distance, has vanished as well.)
strings.(커다란 신전 안의 중심, 수상한 물체가 빛이 머문 금속의 궤도에 갇혀: (At the center of a vast temple, strange objects move slowly within gleaming metal tracks, like the workings of a clock.)
strings.(내가 언제 이곳으로 온 거지…? 아니야. 모크샤에 들어간 것처럼 여기도: (When did I get here...? No. This is just like entering Moksha.)
strings.(놀라 주위를 둘러보는 %s의 행동에 그레모리 퀸이 조소를 보인다.): (The Gremory Queen sneers as %s looks around in surprise.)
strings.아직도 상황 파악이 안 되나요? 허둥대는 꼴을 보니 조심할 필요가 전혀: Still haven't grasped the situation? Watching you flounder, I can't imagine why he thought I should be cautious. Ah, well.
Look at me, %s. Let's make a wager.
strings.이 넓은 노르니르의 눈물 안에서 보물을 찾는 거예요. 먼저 보물을 찾는: We'll search these vast Tears of Nornir for the treasure. The first to find it takes the other's life.
Though first, I intend to dispose of that ill-mannered griffin.
strings.%s, 지금 내가 당신의 의사를 묻는 걸로 보이나요?: %s, do you imagine I'm asking for your consent?
Right. That's how demons do things. You'll do whatever you please, just like the Grand Duke.
Comparing me to the Grand Duke... How do I describe this complicated feeling? Hehe. I'll make an exception and forgive—
Don't get the wrong idea, Gremory Queen.
strings.(그레모리 퀸의 얼굴이 순간 일그러졌지만, 언제 그랬냐는 것처럼 원래대로: (The Gremory Queen's expression twists for an instant, then smooths as though nothing happened.)
I wonder which of us has the wrong idea, %s.
strings.무례한 당신의 목숨. 내가 보물을 찾는 순간, 친히 거둘게요. 바로 그: The moment I find the treasure, I'll personally take your impudent life. Right where you stand... But first, that meddlesome griffin...
strings.(그레모리 퀸이 섬찟한 미소를 보이자, 주위에 모든 것들의 움직임이 멈춘: (The Gremory Queen gives a chilling smile. Everything around her stops moving.)
strings.(모험가가 움직이려고 다가갔지만, 조금 전까지 눈앞에 있던 퀸의 모습은: (The adventurer lunges forward, but the Queen has vanished as though into thin air.)
strings.대공만큼 만만치 않은 상대인 건 분명해. 어쩔 수 없지. 퀸보다 더 빠르: She's clearly as dangerous as the Grand Duke. I have no choice. I have to find the Tear of Time before she does.
strings.(노르니르의 눈물 안으로 들어가기 위해 발을 내딛는 %s의 위로 커다란: (As %s steps farther into the Tears of Nornir, a vast shadow falls overhead.)
strings.(힘찬 날갯짓을 멈춘 커다란 존재가 곧은 자세로 모험가를 응시한다.): (A great creature stills its powerful wings and stands tall, gazing at the adventurer.)
strings.(하이랜드에서 본 일반 그리폰과는 다른 우직하고 용맹한 존재가 조용히 고: (Unlike the ordinary griffins of the Highlands, this creature has a bearing of steadfast courage. It nods quietly.)
strings.(그리폰의 커다란 울음소리와 함께 %s의 머릿속으로 누군가의 음성이 같이: (With the griffin's great cry, a voice echoes inside %s's mind.)
Wh-what? That feels like Lord Atkina's dragon speech...
strings.「그대는 의심하지 말고 나를 볼지어다. 트리샤가 니르바나라 이름 붙인 그: “Cast aside your doubts and look upon me. I am the griffin Trisha named Nirvana.”
strings.(니르바나가 모험가와 눈을 맞추고 다가가려다가 그대로 주저앉는다.): (Nirvana meets the adventurer's eyes and tries to approach, but collapses.)
“That does not matter now, %s. I had to save you before myself. You have already failed to find the Tear of Time before the Gremory Queen many times.”
strings.「그대는 하이랜드에 들어선 순간부터 몇 번이고 죽음을 경험하고 다시 깨어: “Since setting foot in the Highlands, you have died and awakened again, over and over.”
strings.「그래, 믿을 수 없겠지…. 믿을 수 없을 것이다. 하지만, 난 그래야: “Yes, you cannot believe it... Of course you cannot. But I had no choice.”
strings.「이곳을 지키는 것이 트리샤를 지키는 것이기에. 그것이 속죄하는 길이기에: “To protect this place is to protect Trisha. It is my path to atonement. I had to help you.”
strings.「이곳의 시간을 돌려 그대가 다시 일어날 수 있게 하는 것.」: “To turn back time here, so you could rise again.”
Then... Those moments when time seemed to slow...
strings.「그대가 느낀 뒤틀린 시간의 흔들림은 죽음에서 돌아와 다시 시작한 순간들: “The distortions you felt were the moments you returned from death and began anew.”
strings.「…나는, 나는 괜찮다. 그러니 내 말을 계속 들어라. 그대가 시간의 눈: “...I am... I am all right. Listen to me. If you do not claim the Tear of Time, the Gremory Queen will become more than a demon...”
strings.「마신(魔神)이 될 것이다. 그것이 내가 시간을 돌리기 전에 마지막으로: “She will become a demon god. That was the future I last saw before turning back time.”
strings.「이게 나와 너의 마지막 시간이다. 더는 내게 시간이 없다.」: “This is our final chance. I have no more time.”
strings.「그대가 짐작하는 것이 맞다. 시간을 돌리면서 내가 가진 시간을 거의 다: “You are correct. Turning back time has consumed nearly all the time I had left.”
strings.「…지금 내게 마지막 남은 시간마저 사라진다면, 나는 본능만 남은 마수로: “...When the last of my time runs out, I may become a beast ruled only by instinct, and stand in your way.”
strings.「서둘러라. %s. 이리스 님을, 트리샤를, 그리고 모두를 지켜다오. 우: “Hurry, %s. Protect Iris, Trisha, and everyone else. Through every moment of our lives...”
strings.「…만약에 최악의 상황이 다가온다면 ▒▒▒▒에게서 떨어진 ▒▒의 ▒▒로: “...If the worst should happen, use the ▒▒ of ▒▒ dropped by ▒▒▒▒ to ▒▒ the ▒▒...”
strings.(그 말을 끝으로 니르바나가 힘겹게 다시 날아오른다. 그러나 얼마 가지: (With those words, Nirvana struggles into the air again. But he falls out of sight before he can get far.)
strings.(서둘러 앞으로 달려가지만, 니르바나의 모습은 보이지 않는다.): (The adventurer rushes forward, but Nirvana is nowhere to be seen.)
strings.(조금 전의 소란으로 시간의 영역을 돌아다니던 존재들이 천천히 %s의 앞: (Drawn by the commotion, the inhabitants of the realm of time slowly emerge before %s.)
strings.(시간이 형상화된 존재와 정령, 심지어 이곳과는 어울리지 않는 레피카의: (Beings formed of time, spirits, even stray copies of Lepica's cat familiar Nero. All fix their attention on the intruder.)
strings.그렇게 봐도 어쩔 수 없어. 나는 어떻게든 살아남아 이 시간의 끝을 봐야: Stare all you like. I have to survive and see this through to the end.
strings.그러니까 내 남은 시간을 방해하지 마!!: So stay out of the time I have left!
strings.(홀로 시간을 헤매는 외로운 공간. 노르니르의 눈물 끝이란 걸 알려주듯: (In this lonely place of wandering time, morning gradually darkens toward night, as though marking the end of the Tears of Nornir.)
It's like I can see time passing.
strings.분명 시작할 때는 아침이었던 공간이 이젠 밤…. 하루를 다 보냈는데, 이: It was morning when I started, and now it's night... An entire day, and it felt so short.
strings.그런데 시간의 눈물은 어디 있는 거지? 모든 길을 다 찾았는데도 보이지: But where is the Tear of Time? I've searched every path and still can't find it...
strings.(서둘러 어두워지는 길을 향해 달리던 %s의 옆으로 거대한 사이드의 날이: (As %s hurries down the darkening path, the blade of a huge scythe sweeps in from the side.)
strings.(그레모리 퀸이 뒤로 물러나는 %s을 향해 미소 짓는다. 그리고 빠른 속: (The Gremory Queen smiles as %s retreats. She rushes forward, swinging her scythe.)
strings.(모험가가 반격하려고 하지만, 압도적인 퀸의 공격에 막혀 멀리 튕겨나간다: (The adventurer tries to counter, but the Queen's overwhelming attack sends them flying.)
strings.반복되는 시간으로 살짝 성장한 기분이 들었나 보죠? 그래도 내게는 닿지: Did you think reliving these moments made you a little stronger? You still cannot reach me.
I am the queen of demons who command time. Did you think I wouldn't notice?
strings.니르바나 덕분에 마신이 되는 미래를 얻지 못하게 되는 걸 깨달은 순간,: Realizing Nirvana was denying me my future as a demon god was most upsetting.
strings.신도 참 얄궂어요. 신의 영역에 침범한 플루톤 드래곤을 추방시키면서도 신: How cruel the gods are. They banished a Pluton Dragon for trespassing in their realm, yet sentenced him to guard that very realm for eternity.
strings.(니르바나가 원래 플루톤 드래곤이었다고?): (Nirvana used to be a Pluton Dragon?)
strings.이곳에 들어서서 정확히 마흔여섯 번이나 시간의 눈물을 손에 넣었는데도 되: I have claimed the Tear of Time exactly forty-six times since entering, only to be sent back. It's getting tiresome.
strings.그래요. %s도 마흔여섯 번이나 죽었죠. 지겹지 않나요?: Yes. You've died forty-six times as well, %s. Aren't you tired of it?
strings.아닌가? 어차피 다른 시간대의 많은 당신도 죽곤 했으니 그거보단 더 되겠: Or perhaps not. The many other versions of you have died in other timelines, too. So the total must be higher.
strings.당신은 참 신기하군요. 대체 어떤 존재죠? 한낱 인간일 뿐인데, 어떻게: You are fascinating. Just what are you? A mere human, yet somehow... How did you come to be this way?
strings.그런 대답이라니. 당신은 자신을 잘 모르고 있군요. 그러면 시간의 눈물에: What an answer. You really don't know yourself. Then allow me, who has touched the Tear of Time, to explain—
strings.(순간, 그레모리 퀸의 얼굴로 날카로운 공격이 스치고 지나간다. 창백한: (A sharp attack grazes the Gremory Queen's face. Dark green blood trickles from a cut in her pale cheek.)
strings.(그레모리 퀸이 가볍게 웃으며 뺨을 어루만진다. 그러자 상처가 났던 부분: (The Gremory Queen chuckles and strokes her cheek. The wound vanishes.)
I don't want to hear it. I don't need to.
strings.그러면 시간의 눈물에만 집중하겠단 이야기로 알고, 우리 재미있는 시간을: Then I'll take that to mean you'll focus on the Tear of Time. Shall we enjoy ourselves?
strings.무척 즐거울 거예요. 당신을 다시 살려줄 신의 전령도 가진 시간을 다 써: Oh, this will be delightful. The divine messenger who could revive you has spent all his time and become a beast of pure instinct.
Even this realm's guardian has begun to run mad.
strings.그리고 난 당신의 영혼을 아예 흔적조차 남지 않게 만드는 거죠. 자, 나: And I shall erase every last trace of your soul. This forty-seventh cycle will be the last. I will become a demon god.
strings.마족이 신이 돼서 대체 뭐하려고…?: What does a demon want with godhood... ?
At least I'll be better than someone who never wished to become a god.
strings.(이리스를 언급하는 것 같은 퀸의 말에 무기를 쥔 %s의 손에 힘이 들어: (Hearing what seems to be a reference to Iris, %s tightens their grip on their weapon.)
...So eager to throw yourself at me and be disposed of.
strings.자, %s. 똑똑히 지켜보세요. 그레모리 일족의 여왕에서 마신 달리아로: Watch closely, %s. Behold my rebirth, from Queen of the Gremory to Dahlia, the Demon God!
strings.(그레모리 퀸의 외침과 함께 노르니르의 눈물 안의 어둠이 속도를 내며 짙: (At the Gremory Queen's cry, darkness deepens throughout the Tears of Nornir. Her time and %s's flow toward their final moment.)
Stubborn human. How have you lasted this long...?
strings.(그레모리 퀸의 표정이 일그러질 때까지 모험가가 힘겹게 퀸의 공격을 막아: (The adventurer barely fends off the Queen's attacks, enduring until her face twists in frustration.)
Even more persistent than the thirty-second time. Disgusting.
strings.(퀸의 이마에 있던 뿔이 날카로운 칼날처럼 변해 %s의 어깨를 찌른다.): (The horn on the Queen's forehead becomes a sharp blade and pierces %s's shoulder.)
strings.아직도 버틸 오기가 있나요? 이런 고통으로도 포기하지 않는 인간은 정말: Still determined to hold on? It's been so long since a human refused to yield to this much pain—
I-I can't give up! I have to stop you and get the Tear of Time...!
strings.(그레모리 퀸이 피 묻은 뿔을 닦아내며 쓰러진 %s의 모습을 바라본다.): (The Gremory Queen wipes the blood from her horn and looks down at the fallen %s.)
You have no chance left in this timeline. I'll end it quickly and painlessly.
strings.(퀸이 미소를 짓자 사이드에 맴돌고 있던 마력이 폭발한다. 그 순간, 그: (As the Queen smiles, magic erupts from her scythe. At that instant, something flies past her ear into the air.)
strings.(그레모리 퀸이 모험가의 손에 있던 물건이 사라진 걸 확인하고 서둘러 고: (Seeing that the object in the adventurer's hand is gone, the Gremory Queen whips her head around.)
strings.(그레모리 퀸이 손을 뻗어 시간의 힘을 사용하려 하지만, 이미 그건 노르: (The Gremory Queen reaches out to wield her power over time, but the object is already hurtling toward the structure suspended at the center of the Tears of Nornir.)
strings.(모험가가 던진 물건은 그곳에 닿지 않을 수도 있었지만, 언제 깨어났는지: (The throw might have fallen short. But Nirvana, somehow awake again, catches the object in his beak and flies straight into the structure.)
strings.(노르니르의 눈물 안이 거대한 섬광과 엄청난 굉음으로 가득 채워진다.): (A blinding flash and a deafening roar fill the Tears of Nornir.)
strings.(팔을 들어 눈을 가리자 빛이 이내 사라진다. 놀란 모험가가 팔을 내리고: (The adventurer shields their eyes. The light soon fades, and they lower their arm to find an uncanny sight.)
strings.(퀸이 날아가는 물건을 붙잡으려고 했던 그 모습 그대로 멈춰있다. 게다가: (The Queen is frozen with her hand outstretched toward the flying object. Even her sharp scythe, once brimming with magic, gives off nothing.)
That thing moving at the center of the Tears of Nornir... It was the Tear of Time all along.
strings.「…만약에 최악의 상황이 다가온다면 타임키퍼에게서 떨어진 시간의 열쇠로: “...If the worst should happen, use the Key of Time dropped by a Timekeeper to...”
strings.니르바나 말대로 했을 뿐인데, 이렇게 된다니. 니르바나…? 니르바나!!: I only did what Nirvana told me... I never expected this. Nirvana...? Nirvana!
strings.(서둘러 시간의 눈물이 있던 자리로 뛰어가던 %s의 발걸음이 멈춘다.): (%s rushes toward where the Tear of Time stood, then stops short.)
strings.비록 신의 전령이었던 니르바나에게서 방법을 들어 이 상황을 해결하긴 했지: Though Nirvana, once a messenger of the gods, told you how to resolve this... Only you could have accomplished it.
Thanks to you, I can visit this place for the first time in ages.
strings.노르니르의 눈물은 달리아 말대로 시간을 사용할 수 있는 존재만 들어오는: As Dahlia said, only those who could wield time were permitted inside the Tears of Nornir...
strings.이곳 그 자체라 할 수 있는 시간의 눈물이 사라졌으니 더는 의미가 없게: But with the Tear of Time, the very essence of this place, gone, that restriction no longer matters.
strings.(바르바토스가 쓸쓸한 눈빛으로 시간의 눈물이 있던 자리를 바라본다.): (Barbatos looks forlornly at the spot where the Tear of Time once stood.)
What happened to Nirvana...? I haven't found him.
It was his choice. Nirvana's... No, Sanak's.
A Pluton Dragon, banished for gazing into the realm of the gods.
strings.그래도 신은 그를 미워하지 않았습니다. 시간의 눈물이 떨어진 하이랜드에서: Yet the god did not hate him. He was allowed to remain in the Highlands, where the Tear of Time had fallen, in the hope that he would repent.
strings.비스트가 나타나던 시기… 어쩌다 그리폰이 됐는지는 모르겠지만, 그 모습으: Around the time the Beast appeared... I don't know how he became a griffin, but he lived in the Highlands in that form for many years.
And it seems he formed a bond with a human girl.
strings.10년 전, 내가 눈을 뜨고 나타났을 때. 소녀를 지키기 위해 다시 이곳: Ten years ago, when I awakened and appeared here, he must have returned to this place to protect her.
strings.오래 전 신을 지켰던 그때처럼 소녀를 지키기 위해, 지금 이런 선택을 했: Perhaps he made this choice for her sake, just as he once protected a god.
strings.신의 피조물이었던 자가 스스로 신의 능력이 담긴 물건을 파괴했다는 건 그: For a god's own creation to destroy an object imbued with divine power... That speaks to his resolve.
He must have known that defying providence would cost him his very existence...
Without even knowing who its true master was... Well, it no longer matters.
strings.그 물건이 필요해서 손에 넣으려고 했을 뿐인데. 니르바나와 달리아가 다: I simply wanted to obtain an object I needed. Nirvana and Dahlia ruined everything.
Though I expected as much from the moment Dahlia sensed its divine power...
strings.%s, 무기를 쥔 손에 힘이 들어가 있군요. 어차피 이곳에서 싸워봐야 당: Your grip on your weapon is tightening, %s. Fighting here would only cost you.
You remain so easy to read.
strings.시간이 사라진 신의 영역은 이제 곧 위대한 벽 사이 틈으로 흘러 들어갈: This divine realm, stripped of time, will soon drift into a gap in the Great Wall.
strings.신의 영역은 신께 맡기기로 하고, 아직 신으로 돌아가지 못한 자는 이만: I shall leave the gods' domain to the gods. One who has yet to regain godhood should take his leave. Even a great being cannot easily escape those gaps...
And the day of your trial is fast approaching...
strings.(바르바토스를 붙잡으려 하지만, 어디선가 나타난 검은 나비가 바르바토스: (The adventurer tries to seize Barbatos, but a black butterfly appears and circles him. They vanish together.)
strings.(바르바토스가 사라진 자리를 바라보고 있을 때, 눈앞에 검은 구멍이 펼쳐: (As the adventurer stares at the empty space, a black hole opens before them. Through it looms the shadow of the monster from Moksha.)
strings.(그런 %s의 앞으로 작은 빛이 다가온다. 빛은 마치 %s의 주위를 맴돌: (A small light approaches %s. It circles %s, then reveals a path that was invisible a moment before.)
That way...? I suppose it's my only option...
That woman's power... The Gremory Queen's power has diminished. No, it seems to have stopped moving. She isn't dead, though...
And the Grand Duke's faint presence has vanished, too.
strings.바르바토스가 사라졌다면 분명 더는 이곳에 볼일이 없다는 것이지. %s 님: If Barbatos has left, he has no further business here. Either %s succeeded, or failed.
I'd call it a success. Look, Father.
strings.(로말리우스가 가리킨 쪽에 있던 문 앞으로 신비한 빛이 몰려와 사원의 기: (Where Romalius points, a mysterious light gathers before the gate and rises like a temple pillar.)
strings.(그리고 빛이 사라진 자리엔 그들이 기다리고 있던 사람이 서 있었다.): (When the light fades, the person they have been waiting for stands there.)
strings.괜찮으십니까, %s 님? 지금 기도를 받고 들어가신 게 10분이 채 되지: Are you all right, %s? It hasn't even been ten minutes since I prayed for you and you went inside...
Judging by your reaction, %s, time must flow differently in there.
In any case, I'm glad you've returned safely.
strings.%s 님, 실례가 되지 않는다면 안의 상황을 간단하게 말씀해주실 수 있겠: If you don't mind, %s, could you briefly tell us what happened inside?
strings.그 기도문을 들려드린 순간, 교황께서도 아실 것 같지만…. 그래도 따로: The pontiff may already know, since I recited that prayer... But I should still make a proper report.
Of course. You helped me, after all. What happened was...
strings.(칼루소에게 간단하게 노르니르의 눈물 안에서 있었던 일을 이야기한다. 마: (I give Caluso a brief account of what happened in the Tears of Nornir, including the forty-six repetitions of time.)
strings.트리샤의 그리폰이 신의 전령이었고, 모두를 지키기 위해서 스스로 신의 물: Trisha's griffin was a divine messenger... And to protect everyone, he destroyed a divine relic, knowing he would cease to exist...
When Barbatos said he would become a god, I thought it was just cult nonsense...
strings.대공은 더는 하이랜드에 없고, 그레모리 퀸은 시간이 멈춘 세계에 갇혀 다: Then the Grand Duke has left the Highlands, and the Gremory Queen is trapped in a world of stopped time, drifting into a gap in spacetime.
strings.(이곳에 와서도 시간이 느려졌다 돌아가지 않는 걸 보니….): (Time hasn't slowed and returned to normal since I got out...)
strings.(다 끝났지. 그러면 이리스에게 다시 갈 수 있는 건가?): (It's over. Does that mean I can go back to Iris?)
strings.(언제 나타났는지 %s의 곁으로 작은 빛의 구가 다가와 맴돈다.): (A small orb of light appears beside %s and circles them.)
I'm honored that you know my name, Lady Iris...
I was a little worried when I couldn't find you, %s. But I'm all right now.
Everything is back to normal. I'm so glad I can hear your voice.
strings.이리스에게 해줄 이야기가 많아. 나 이리스에게 돌아가기 전에 먼저 다녀올: I have so much to tell you, Iris. But there's somewhere I need to go before I come back to you.
strings.(%s의 대답과 함께 성스러운 빛은 불어오는 바람에 실려 어디론가 사라진: (At %s's reply, the sacred light drifts away on the breeze.)
...I never dreamed I would see that sacred light so close.
I wanted to hear the goddess's voice, too. I suppose being a demon made that impossible. Ah, well. Perhaps I'll have to be reborn.
strings.힘내게, 마족 청년. 때가 되면 여신님께서도 로말리우스의 뜻을 알아줄 거: Take heart, young demon. When the time comes, the goddess will understand your intentions, too.
strings.이제 이곳의 일은 다 끝나신 겁니까?: Is your work here finished, then?
I want to tell Trisha about Nirvana before I leave.
strings.…그건 제가 틈을 봐서 트리샤에게 이야기하겠습니다. 지금이라면 너무 혼란: ...Allow me to find the right moment to tell her. I fear it would be too much for her to take in right now...
Oh, I see... Then I'll leave that to you, Father.
Goodbye to you, too, Romalius. Good luck with your work.
It was a pleasure meeting you, %s. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.
strings.조심해서 돌아가시길 빌겠습니다. %s 님. 노르니르의 행복한 시간이 함께: I pray for your safe return, %s. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.
I'll do my best to make that wish come true.
(The moment Arche sees %s arrive in Pneuma, she rushes over and throws her arms around them.)
strings.(뒤로 물러난 아르케의 눈가가 퉁퉁 부어있다.): (Arche steps back. Her eyes are badly swollen.)
Oh, dear... My eyes must be all puffy.
strings.(아르케의 손짓에 어디선가 아에루라가 날아와 아르케의 얼굴을 문지른다.): (At Arche's gesture, an Aerura flies over and rubs against her face.)
strings.%s 님의 시간이 돌아오면서 프뉴마에 있던 정령들도 다시 활기를 되찾았어: Now that your time has returned, %s, the spirits in Pneuma have their energy back, too!
strings.다행이에요. 크로노스와 카이로스도 괜찮은 거겠죠?: That's a relief. Chronos and Kairos are all right, too?
You have no idea how happy I am to see them bickering again.
strings.이제 괜찮은 거라고, 아무 일도 일어나지 않을 거라고 이야기하고 싶지만,: I wish I could say everything will be all right now, that nothing more will happen. But I don't know.
I'm afraid of what else might happen to you and Iris, %s.
It'll be all right, Arche. Try not to worry so much.
Gaia wouldn't want to see you so anxious, either.
strings.혹시 이리스 님을 만나러 가시는 길이세요?: Are you on your way to see Iris?
After I've thanked everyone who helped me.
strings.그러시구나. 다음은 이르판 님이시죠?: I see. Irfan is next, then?
That's right. I'm sorry I can't stay longer, Arche.
That's all right, %s. You can come back another time.
I promise I will. See you soon.
Thank you for your help, Irfan.
You needn't thank me. Save your gratitude for her.
That hardly sounds heartfelt. Still, I shall pass on her words.
strings.마치 장난의 신이 개입한 것 같은 상황을 의외로 잘 해결했다며 칭찬해 주: She commends you for handling the situation surprisingly well. It was almost as though a god of mischief had intervened.
I appreciate the praise, but none of this was a joke...
strings.다른 말이 하고 싶은 건가? 그렇다면 장난친 뱀을 잡아 죽인 다음에 하: Have something more to say? Then catch and kill the serpent behind the mischief first.
strings.다행인지 아닌지 모르겠지만, 이제 자넨 이면의 세계였던 장소로도 자유롭게: Whether it's a blessing or not, you can now freely visit the place that was the Reverse Side.
The path to Yggdrasil's Reverse Side will remain open.
Don't look so surprised. Go and see.
Someone there seems to be waiting for news of you.
All right, Irfan. Until next time.
How did you come back here? Wait a moment...
strings.(엘리가 웃고 있지만, 눈가엔 눈물이 고여있다. 옷소매로 닦아내지만, 기: (Ellie smiles through brimming eyes. She wipes them with her sleeve, but cannot hide her tears of joy.)
strings.난 널 믿었어. 네 이면과 정면의 시간에서 일어나는 일을 모두 해결할 거: I believed in you. I knew you'd resolve everything happening in your time on both the Reverse Side and the Front Side...
strings.아, 미안해요. 안부를 전해달라고 한 사람이 누군지 모르겠어요. 그리고: Oh, I'm sorry. I don't know who you wanted me to give your regards to. I can't even remember exactly what you said...
No, you've already passed them on. Thank you.
I have? What do you mean... ?
You don't have to understand just yet. You will someday. Hehe.
strings.…네 이야기를 듣고 싶지만, 비그리드엔 잠깐 온 거지?: ...I'd love to hear your story, but you're only stopping by Vigrid, aren't you?
Yes. I need to see Iris.
strings.그래, 알았어. 지금 네겐 휴식 같은 이리스가 필요해 보여. 괜찮다고 말: Of course. You look as though you need the comfort Iris brings you. You may say you're fine, but you've lived through so many different currents of time...
I'm sorry there's nothing I can do for you.
You don't know how happy that makes me. So...
Come and visit from time to time.
strings.그러면 이제 가봐…. 비그리드에서 날 처음 만났던 장소에서 다시 돌아갈: Then off you go... You can return from the place where we first met in Vigrid.
strings.(시간이 없으니까 아드키나 님과 지엔디아 님은 나중에 봐야겠다…. 일단: (I'll have to visit Lord Atkina and Jiendia later. There isn't time... I need to see Iris first...)
strings.(엘리가 떠나는 %s의 모습을 바라보며 손을 크게 흔든다.): (Ellie waves broadly as she watches %s leave.)
strings.지엔디아도 지금쯤이면 기이 태자를 다시 만났겠네. 잘 지내야 해, 지엔디: Jiendia must have met Crown Prince Guiyi again by now. Take care of yourself, Jiendia.
strings.(마중 나온 이리스가 %s의 얼굴을 보자마자 환하게 웃는다. 긴장이 풀린: (Iris greets %s with a radiant smile. The adventurer's tension melts away, and they sink to the ground in relief.)
You always say you're fine, %s. Though I suppose I do, too.
strings.(이리스가 주저앉은 %s에게 손을 내밀어 일어날 수 있게 해준다.): (Iris offers %s a hand and helps them stand.)
strings.고마워, 이리스. 정말 많은 일이 있었어. 조금 더 빨리 왔으면 좋았을: Thank you, Iris. So much happened. I wish I could have come back sooner...
strings.내가 이럴 동안 이리스에게는 별일 없었어?: Did anything happen to you while I was away?
strings.쉽게 움직일 수 없었어요. %s에게 다가가려고 한다면 위대한 벽을 포함한: I couldn't move freely. If I'd tried to approach you, %s, I might have destabilized time, including the Great Wall...
It's all right, Iris. I want to rest, but I have so much to talk to you about. Do you have time?
We have plenty of time. There's no need to hurry.
strings.(이리스와 어떤 이야기를 나누지?): (What should I talk to Iris about?)
strings.폐하께서 지켜보기만 하라고 했지만, 지엔디아 님을 구하려고 나섰던 순간…: Her Majesty told me to watch without interfering. But the moment I tried to save Jiendia, time and space split into a Front Side and a Reverse Side, with me at the center.
strings.바로 이면의 시간과 공간인 비그리드의 일을 해결하고 정면의 시간과 공간으: I put things right in Vigrid, on the Reverse Side, and returned to the Front Side.
strings.시간의 영역에 있는 보물, 시간의 눈물을 노리는 그레모리 퀸과 싸우면서: Then I lived through the same stretch of time over and over, fighting the Gremory Queen for the Tear of Time, the treasure of the realm of time.
I barely escaped by following Nirvana's instructions, but...
strings.만약 내가 폐하의 예언대로 했다면 어떻게 됐을까? 조금 전까지는 아무렇지: What would have happened if I'd followed Her Majesty's prophecy? It hadn't bothered me until now, but the moment I saw you, I started wondering.
I'll tell you everything I know.
strings.카이나 황제께서 보신 미래는 하나가 아니에요. 비그리드를 거쳐 하이랜드를: Empress Kaina saw more than one future. Your journey through Vigrid and the Highlands was among them...
strings.여러 조각의 미래를 조합해 최선의 방향을 제시하셨어요. 그리고 나머지는: She pieced together fragments of those futures to point you toward the best outcome. The rest she entrusted to you, %s.
strings.……지엔디아 님을 구할 것도 아셨던 것 같고, 모든 걸 해결하고 돌아오리: ...I think she knew you would save Jiendia, and that you would resolve everything and return.
strings.이리스, 언젠가 아드키나 님께서 그런 말씀을 하신 적이 있어. 폐하의 능: Iris, Lord Atkina once told me something. That Her Majesty's power was almost divine...
That she might be a demigod, or something like one.
strings.그런 존재인지는 모르겠어요. 그래도 제가 노르니르의 눈물을 알게 되고 영: I don't know if that's what she is. But as I learned of the Tears of Nornir and felt their effects, I realized something.
Empress Kaina is also looking into the gaps in the Great Wall.
Then it all makes sense. It does, but...
strings.받아들이기 힘들다는 걸 알아요. 이게 폐하에 대해선 제가 말씀드릴 수 있: I know it's hard to accept. That's all I can tell you about Her Majesty...
All right. I'll figure out the rest somehow.
strings.(폐하가 숨기고 있는 걸 알아야 해.): (I have to find out what Her Majesty is hiding.)
strings.혹시 이리스도 느꼈어? 노르니르의 눈물 안에서 몇 번이나 시간이 되돌아간: Did you feel it, too, Iris? All those times that time reversed inside the Tears of Nornir...
strings.네, 비록 다가갈 수는 없었지만…. 그 안에서 %s의 모든 것이 사라져가: Yes. Though I couldn't reach you... I felt every moment that everything you were began to fade, %s...
Forty-six times. Every one of them...
I should have put things right sooner.
It's all right. You're here in front of me now.
strings.알았어. 이리스가 괜찮다면 괜찮은 거겠지?: All right. If you say it's all right, then it is. Right?
strings.맞아요. 제가 괜찮다면 괜찮은 거예요. 에트와르의 성계신이 괜찮다는데 누: Exactly. If I say it's all right, it's all right. Who's going to argue with Etoile's God of the Astral Realm?
strings.그런데, 이리스. 알고 있겠지만, 나는 여러 갈래의 시간 속에서 서로 다: But Iris, as you know, I've been different people in different branches of time.
strings.어느 게 진짜 나인지는 모르겠지만, 여기 이리스 앞에 있는 서 있는 내가: I don't know which one was the real me. But the person standing here before you must be me, right?
strings.어렴풋이 생각나. 언제부턴가 머릿속에 이리스의 이름이 각인된 것처럼 떠올: I vaguely remember it. At some point, your name began to surface in my mind, as if it had been carved there. I became certain I had to meet you.
strings.내 과거와 의지는 상관없이 그게 마치 운명인 것처럼, 물론, 지금은 그런: As if it were destiny, regardless of my past or my own will. Of course, now I believe I belong at your side, whatever brought me here.
strings.그래서 묻고 싶은 게 있어. 이리스는 언제부터 날 알게 된 거야?: So there's something I want to ask. When did you first become aware of me?
When I was dreaming, at a moment when I needed someone...
A door opened, and a path appeared. And there, I saw you, %s.
strings.나도 꿈에서 그 문을 본 것 같은데…. 미안, 이리스는 보지 못했던 것: I think I saw that door in a dream, too... Sorry, I don't think I saw you.
Whatever happened, I'm glad we were able to meet.
strings.(꿈의 길, 그건 진짜 꿈이었던 걸까….): (The path in the dream... Was it really a dream?)
strings.시간의 영역은 노르니르의 눈물 말고도 많은 장소가 있어요. 어떤 모습으로: There are many realms of time besides the Tears of Nornir. I don't know what forms they take...
But they must be as varied as time is boundless.
strings.앞으로 이런 일이 또 일어날 경우 노르니르의 눈물 같은 장소를 가야 하는: If something like this happens again, I'll have to visit another place like the Tears of Nornir.
I'll keep watch over the Great Wall and do what I can to prevent that.
strings.그러면 그레모리 퀸은 시간이 멈춘 채로 그 안에서 갇힌 거야?: So the Gremory Queen is trapped in there, with time stopped?
strings.네, 산 것도, 죽은 것도 아닌 채로 그렇게 거기 있게 되겠죠. 그토록: Yes. Neither alive nor dead, she will remain there. Subject only to the time she so desperately wanted...
Did the Grand Duke plan even that... ?
strings.바르바토스를 아는 신이 가까이에 계시면 물어보기라도 할 텐데, 아직도 정: If a god who knew Barbatos were nearby, I could ask them. But we still know so little.
A god who knows the Grand Duke...
strings.저도 그분을 떠올리긴 했지만, 엘리시아 밖으로 나오긴 힘들다고 알고 있어: I thought of her, too. But I understand it's difficult for her to leave Elysia.
strings.(그러면 직접 알아낼 수밖에 없겠네….): (Then I'll have to find out for myself...)
Hilda's friend who came with a cat? They were arguing terribly.
Oh, Lepica made it. That's a relief.
strings.레피카도 힐다처럼 아무에게도 상처입히고 싶지 않고, 죽기도 싫어서 도망: Like Hilda, Lepica was on the run because she didn't want to hurt anyone, or be killed herself.
Thanks to you, %s, I've met someone I can enjoy talking to. I'm so happy.
I'm glad you've found someone you enjoy talking to.
strings.예전에 힐다가 머물렀던 곳에 있어요. 제 뜻이 있어야만 머물 수 있는 그: Where Hilda stayed before. It's a place people can remain only with my permission.
When the time is right, let's go together. With our friends.
Don't worry too much about Lepica. She's kind, lively, and optimistic.
strings.(이리스의 어깨 위에 검은 고양이 털 몇 개가 묻어 있다.): (A few black cat hairs cling to Iris's shoulder.)
strings.(흠, 이리스가 말한 장소는 대체 어떤 곳일까? 궁금하지만, 나중을 기약: (Hmm. What sort of place does Iris mean? I'm curious, but it can wait...)
strings.…이리스, 나…. 여기서 잠깐 쉬어도 될까?: ...Iris, could I... rest here for a little while?
Now that I've relaxed, I can barely keep my eyes open. I'm so sleepy...
Of course. As long as you like.
strings.(이리스의 대답을 들은 모험가가 뒤쪽에 있는 꽃밭에 몸을 뉘인다. 그리고: (Hearing Iris's answer, the adventurer lies down in the flower bed behind them. Looking up at Iris, they close their eyes and drift off.)
strings.베개 없으면 불편할 텐데…. 대신할 게 없나? 우리 할머니도 내가 이러고: You'll be uncomfortable without a pillow... Is there something I could use? Whenever I slept like this, my grandmother always brought me a pillow...
strings.(이리스가 %s의 머리에 둘 베개 대용품을 찾던 중, 문득 할머니란 말이: (As Iris searches for something to put beneath %s's head, she is startled by the word that has slipped from her lips.)
strings.내가, 내가 왜 그동안 할머니를 잊고 있었지………?!: Why... Why have I forgotten my grandmother all this time...?!
Surely you did not forget her because you wished to.
strings.(그런 이리스의 앞으로 작고 어두운 구체가 하나가 나타난다. 구체 속에서: (A small, dark orb appears before Iris. Faint light seeps from it, spreading until it fills the Oracle Chamber.)
strings.(안개처럼 퍼진 빛이 퍼졌다 사라지자 그 가운데서 검은 옷을 입은 여성이: (As the mistlike light disperses, a woman dressed in black appears at its center and approaches Iris.)
Iris. Child who has succeeded Seres.
strings.(헤캬테가 이리스를 보더니 가볍게 미소를 짓는다. 그리고 살며시 안아주며: (Hecate smiles faintly at Iris, draws her into a gentle embrace, and whispers in her ear.)
You were speaking of me with that mortal.
Forgive me, child. I did not mean to frighten you. Please understand.
One of Gaia's chambers, if I recall. And now you use it.
Let us say I owe it to that sleeping mortal and the Tear of Time.
strings.네게 받을 것이 있다. 내가 세레스에게 나눠준 것, 그러니까 세레스에게서: There is something I must receive from you. Something I shared with Seres. Something you, in turn, inherited from her.
